steak_sandwich_with_brie_soft_eggs_onion.title: STEAK SANDWICH WITH BRIE, SOFT EGGS, ONIONS AND MUSHROOMS
steak_sandwich_with_brie_soft_eggs_onion.time_line: ⏱ About 60 minutes (pan 1, pan 2 and the oven grill). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Beef steak: 750 g (about 125 g per sandwich)
ingredients.name: Beef steak

ingredients.text: Butter: 65 g (45 g for the mushrooms, 20 g for the eggs)
ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.note: (45 g for the mushrooms, 20 g for the eggs)

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 30 ml (2 tablespoons), for the onions
ingredients.name: Olive oil

ingredients.text: Vegetable oil: 45 ml (1 tablespoon per steak batch)
ingredients.name: Vegetable oil

ingredients.text: Salt: 3 teaspoons in total (the steps say how much goes where)
ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.note: in total (the steps say how much goes where)

equipment: 2 large pans, baking tray, foil, cling film, tongs, spatula, toaster

steps.text: Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before you start cooking.
Peel the onions. Cut each onion in half, then into thin half-rings, about 3 mm.
Wipe the mushrooms with a damp paper towel. Cut them into slices about 5 mm thick.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Cut the brie into 6 equal pieces (40 g each). Keep them in the fridge.
Pat the steak dry with paper towel. Look for the fine lines in the meat. Cut ACROSS those lines into slices about 1 cm thick.
Lay the slices on a plate in one layer. Cover with cling film. Wash the knife, the board and your hands.
Crack the 12 eggs into a bowl. Add the milk, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. Do not whisk yet.
Heat the olive oil in pan 1 on medium-low heat.
Add the onions and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes.
Move the onions to a bowl. Wipe pan 1 with paper towel.
Heat pan 2 on medium-high for 2 minutes.
Add 45 g of butter and let it melt.
Add the mushrooms in one layer. If they do not fit, cook them in 2 batches.
Leave them for 3 minutes without stirring.
Stir. Cook 4 to 5 more minutes, until golden and no water is left in the pan.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Move the mushrooms to a bowl and stir in 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Wipe pan 2.
Sprinkle the slices with 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper, on both sides.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Heat pan 2 on high for 3 minutes.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Flick a drop of water in. It must sizzle and disappear at once.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of vegetable oil and swirl.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Lay about 7 slices in the pan in one layer, not touching each other.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Fry for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes on the first side. Do not move them.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Turn each slice with tongs.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Fry for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on the second side.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Move the slices to a plate and cover with foil.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Repeat steps 23 to 28 for the second and third batches.
steps.section: COOK THE STEAK (pan 2, 3 batches of about 7 slices)

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with a fork for 20 seconds, until the colour is even.
Melt 20 g of butter in pan 1 on LOW heat.
Pour in the eggs and wait 20 seconds.
Stir slowly and all the time, pushing the egg from the edges to the middle, for 5 to 6 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat at once. Cover it with foil.
Turn the oven grill on to high. Put the oven shelf about 15 cm below the grill.
Toast all 12 slices of bread in the toaster.
Put 6 slices on a baking tray. Put one piece of brie on each.
Put the tray under the grill for 1 to 2 minutes, until the brie is soft and bubbling at the edges. Stay next to the oven.
Take the tray out. Put the steak slices on the melted brie, about 125 g on each.
Spoon the scrambled eggs on top, about 2 eggs on each.
Add some onions and mushrooms.
Put a second slice of toast on top. Press gently.
Cut each sandwich in half and put them on a warm platter. Serve hot.

ready_when: ✅ ONIONS ARE READY WHEN: they are very soft, deep golden brown and smell sweet. Do not hurry them. Pale onions are not sweet.
✅ STEAK IS READY WHEN: the slices are brown outside and still pink inside. Cut the thickest slice open to check.
✅ EGGS ARE READY WHEN: soft, creamy and still a little shiny.
warnings: ⚠️ Brie melts fast. Never leave it under the grill alone.
⚠️ If your oven has no grill, put the tray in the oven at 200°C for 4 minutes instead.
⚠️ Do not stir the mushrooms in the first 3 minutes. They need time to brown.

steak_sandwich_with_brie_soft_eggs_onion.description_ru: Ломтики стейка, мягкий скрэмбл, карамелизованный лук и грибы на безглютеновом хлебе

beef_and_pepper_breakfast_skillet_with_c.title: BEEF AND PEPPER BREAKFAST SKILLET WITH CHEESE AND SMOKY MAYO
beef_and_pepper_breakfast_skillet_with_c.time_line: ⏱ 35 minutes (pan 1 and pan 2 at the same time). Start at T minus 40 min.

ingredients.text: Lean ground beef: 1200 g (600 g per pan)
ingredients.name: Lean ground beef

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 180 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: Vegetable oil: 30 ml (1 tablespoon per pan)
ingredients.name: Vegetable oil

equipment: 2 large pans with lids (or foil), 3 bowls, spatula, thermometer

steps.text: In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon of paprika, the chili flakes and the lime juice.
Cover the bowl and put it in the fridge.
Cut each pepper in half, take out the seeds and cut into cubes of about 1 cm.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Crack 6 eggs into a bowl. Do the same in a second bowl.
Whisk each bowl with a fork for 20 seconds, until the colour is even.
Mix the salt, the pepper and 2 teaspoons of paprika in a small bowl. Divide it in two.
Heat both large pans on medium-high for 2 minutes.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil to each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Put half of the peppers (225 g) in each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until slightly soft.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Add 600 g of ground beef to each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Break the beef into small pieces with the spatula.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Sprinkle half of the spice mix over the beef in each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring every minute, until the beef is brown all over with no pink left.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Push the thermometer into the beef. It must read at least 74°C.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: If there is a lot of fat in the pan, spoon it into a bowl. Throw it in the bin, not down the sink.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Turn the heat to medium-low.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Pour 6 beaten eggs into each pan over the beef.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes, until the eggs are just set but still a little shiny.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Sprinkle 90 g of cheese over each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Cover each pan with a lid for 1 to 2 minutes, until the cheese melts.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Spoon everything onto one big warm platter.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

steps.text: Drizzle the smoky mayo over the top in zigzag lines.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans at the same time)

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: no pink beef is left, the eggs are set but soft, and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add the eggs until the beef has no pink left.
⚠️ If the cheese does not melt, give it 1 more minute under the lid.

cauliflower_fried_rice_with_egg_carrot_a.title: CAULIFLOWER "FRIED RICE" WITH EGG, CARROT AND PEAS
cauliflower_fried_rice_with_egg_carrot_a.description: A light side dish. Serve it next to a main dish, not instead of one.
cauliflower_fried_rice_with_egg_carrot_a.time_line: ⏱ 30 minutes (1 large pan, 2 batches). Start at T minus 35 min.

ingredients.text: Peas in pods (sugar snap peas): 120 g
ingredients.name: Peas in pods (sugar snap peas)

ingredients.text: Tamari sauce: 60 ml (4 tablespoons). This is the gluten-free soy sauce.
ingredients.name: Tamari sauce
ingredients.note: (4 tablespoons). This is the gluten-free soy sauce.

equipment: Grater, large non-stick pan, clean kitchen towel, bowls

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into florets. Cut off the hard stalks.
Grate the florets on the large holes of the grater into a big bowl. You want pieces the size of rice grains.
Put the grated cauliflower in a clean kitchen towel. Twist the towel and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Peel the carrots. Cut them into thin matchsticks, about 5 mm.
Cut the peas in half.
Peel the onion and cut it into thin half-rings. Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Crack the eggs into a bowl. Whisk with a fork for 20 seconds.
Heat the large pan on medium-high for 2 minutes.
Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil and pour in the eggs.
Stir for 30 to 40 seconds, until scrambled in small pieces.
Move the eggs to a bowl.
Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil to the pan.
Add half of the onion and half of the carrots. Fry for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add half of the garlic and half of the peas. Stir for 30 seconds.
Add half of the cauliflower (500 g). Fry for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until slightly soft and a little golden.
Pour in 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of tamari. Stir for 1 minute, until most of the liquid is gone.
Stir in half of the scrambled eggs.
Move everything to a warm bowl and cover with foil.
Repeat steps 12 to 17 with the second half of the ingredients and the last tablespoon of oil.
Mix both batches together. Add 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper and stir.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cauliflower is soft but not mushy, and the dish looks dry, with golden flecks.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not skip the squeezing in step 3. Wet cauliflower turns into a soggy porridge.
⚠️ Do not add salt. Tamari is already salty.
⚠️ If the pan looks wet after step 15, cook 1 more minute on high heat before adding the tamari.
cauliflower_fried_rice_with_egg_carrot_a.description_ru: Лёгкий гарнир: цветная капуста, яйцо, морковь и горошек

french_creamy_eggs.title: FRENCH CREAMY EGGS
french_creamy_eggs.description: 2 eggs per portion. A light dish. Serve it next to a main dish.
french_creamy_eggs.time_line: ⏱ 20 minutes. Start at T minus 20 min. Eggs are cooked LAST.

ingredients.text: Butter: 120 g, cold from the fridge
ingredients.name: Butter

ingredients.text: Salt: 1 teaspoon (added at the very end)
ingredients.name: Salt

equipment: 1 large heavy saucepan, spatula, bowl, warm platter

steps.text: Cut the cold butter into cubes of about 1 cm.
Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Whisk gently with a fork for 15 seconds. Do not beat them hard. Do NOT add salt.
Rinse the platter with hot water and dry it.
Put the eggs and the butter cubes together into the COLD saucepan.
Put the pan on LOW heat (2 out of 10).
Stir all the time with the spatula, scraping the bottom and the sides.
Keep stirring for 8 to 10 minutes. The eggs thicken slowly.
When lumps start to form fast, or the bottom of the pan is very hot, lift the pan off the heat for 10 seconds and keep stirring. Then put it back.
Repeat step 9 as often as you need.
Take the pan off the heat when the eggs are creamy and thick but still a little runny, like thick porridge.
Stir in the sour cream. This stops the cooking.
Add the salt and stir.
Pour into the warm platter and serve at once.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: velvety, glossy and loose, with small soft curds.
warnings: ⚠️ Never use high heat. High heat makes scrambled eggs hard and dry.
⚠️ Slightly undercooked is correct. The eggs keep setting from their own heat.
⚠️ Serve at once. These eggs get firm within minutes.
french_creamy_eggs.description_ru: Очень нежный кремовый скрэмбл на сливочном масле

deviled_eggs.title: DEVILED EGGS
deviled_eggs.description: 24 halves, 4 halves per portion. A cold dish. Make it before the hot dishes.
deviled_eggs.time_line: ⏱ 50 minutes, mostly waiting. Start at T minus 55 min.
equipment: Large pot with a lid, bowl, teaspoon, sharp knife, large platter, timer

steps.text: Put the eggs in the pot. Lower them gently with a spoon so they do not crack.
Pour in cold water until it is 2 cm above the eggs.
Put the pot on high heat and bring to a boil.
As soon as it boils, turn the heat off and put the lid on.
Start the timer for 11 minutes.
When the timer rings, pour out the hot water.
Fill the pot with cold water (add ice if you have it) and leave for 10 minutes.
Tap each egg on the counter and roll it gently to crack the shell all around.
Peel each egg under a little running water. The shell comes off easier.
Cut each egg in half lengthwise with a sharp knife.
Scoop the yolks into a bowl with a teaspoon.
Put the whites on the platter, hollow side up.
Mash the yolks with a fork until there are no lumps.
Add the mayonnaise, mustard, lime juice, salt and pepper.
Mix until smooth and creamy.
Spoon the yolk mixture back into the whites, about 1 heaped teaspoon in each half (24 halves).
Sprinkle the paprika over the top.
Cover the platter and keep it in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the filling is smooth and fluffy, piled up in each white, and the eggs are cold.
warnings: ⚠️ A grey-green ring around the yolk means the eggs cooked too long. They are still safe to eat.
⚠️ Do not add more lime juice. Too much makes the filling runny and sour.
deviled_eggs.description_ru: Варёные яйца с майонезной начинкой и паприкой, холодное блюдо

greek_salmon_with_feta_and_fresh_vegetab.title: GREEK SALMON WITH FETA AND FRESH VEGETABLES
greek_salmon_with_feta_and_fresh_vegetab.time_line: ⏱ 40 minutes (oven). Start at T minus 45 min.

ingredients.text: Salmon fillet: 1080 g (6 pieces of 180 g)
ingredients.name: Salmon fillet

ingredients.text: Limes: 4 (the juice of 3 = about 90 ml, and 1 for slicing)
ingredients.name: Limes
ingredients.note: (the juice of 3 = about 90 ml, and 1 for slicing)

equipment: Large baking dish (or 2 smaller ones), 2 bowls, thermometer

steps.text: Put the oven shelf in the middle. Turn the oven on to 190°C.
Squeeze 3 limes into a large bowl. You need about 90 ml of juice. Remove the seeds.
Cut the 4th lime into thin rounds.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Add the olive oil, the garlic, the oregano and the chili flakes to the lime juice.
Whisk with a fork for 20 seconds.
Cut the feta into cubes of about 1 cm.
Add the feta to the bowl and toss gently so every cube is coated.
Cover the bowl and put it in the fridge.
Peel the red onions. Cut one into thin half-rings. Chop the other into small cubes of about 5 mm. Keep them in two separate piles.
Cut the tomatoes into cubes of about 2 cm.
Cut the cucumber into cubes of about 1 cm.
Cut each olive in half.
Chop the dill finely.
Put the lime rounds and the onion half-rings on the bottom of the baking dish.
Pat the salmon dry with paper towel.
Put the salmon on top of the onions, skin side down, with space between the pieces.
Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper over the 6 pieces.
Put the dish in the middle of the hot oven.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. Take the dish out at 60°C. If it reads less, bake 2 more minutes and check again.
Take the bowl with the feta out of the fridge.
Add the tomatoes, cucumber, olives, chopped onion and dill.
Fold gently with a spoon, 4 or 5 turns. Do not crush the feta.
Move the salmon with a wide spatula onto a large platter. Add the lime rounds and onions.
Spoon the feta topping over the salmon.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the salmon flakes easily with a fork and is pale pink all the way through, and the topping is fresh and chunky.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not bake past 60°C. Salmon turns dry and chalky.
⚠️ Feta and olives are salty. Do not add any more salt to the topping.
greek_salmon_with_feta_and_fresh_vegetab.description_ru: Запечённый лосось с помидорами, огурцом, фетой и маслинами

cheeseburger_cabbage_wraps.title: CHEESEBURGER CABBAGE WRAPS
cheeseburger_cabbage_wraps.description: A burger wrapped in a cabbage leaf instead of a bun.
cheeseburger_cabbage_wraps.time_line: ⏱ 45 minutes (pot, pan 1 and pan 2). Start at T minus 50 min.

ingredients.text: Lean ground beef: 900 g (6 patties of 150 g)
ingredients.name: Lean ground beef

ingredients.text: Cabbage: 1 head (you need 6 large whole leaves)
ingredients.name: Cabbage

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 120 g (6 slices of 20 g)
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: Salt: 1 3/4 teaspoons (1 1/2 for the patties, 1/4 for the sauce)
ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.note: (1 1/2 for the patties, 1/4 for the sauce)

equipment: Large pot, 2 large pans with a lid or foil, tongs, spatula, thermometer, paper towels

steps.text: Peel the garlic, crush it with the flat side of a knife and chop it finely.
Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, garlic, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1 pinch of pepper in a bowl. Whisk until smooth.
Cover the sauce and put it in the fridge.
Cut the red onion into thin rounds.
Cut the tomatoes into slices about 5 mm thick.
Cut the pickled cucumbers into slices about 3 mm thick.
Cut the cheese into 6 slices.
Divide the beef into 6 equal balls (150 g each).
Press each ball into a flat patty about 2 cm thick and 10 cm across.
Press a shallow dimple into the middle of each patty with your thumb. This stops the patty from puffing up.
Sprinkle the patties with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and 3/4 teaspoon of pepper in total, on both sides.
Cut the hard white core out of the bottom of the cabbage head.
Peel off 6 large whole leaves without tearing them.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Using tongs, dip one leaf into the boiling water for 30 seconds. Do the same with the other 5 leaves.
Put the leaves on a plate lined with paper towel and pat them dry.
With a knife, shave down the thick white rib at the bottom of each leaf so that it is flatter. This helps the leaf fold.
Heat both pans on medium-high for 3 minutes.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Add 1 teaspoon (5 ml) of oil to each pan.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Lay 3 patties in each pan, not touching each other.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Cook for 4 to 5 minutes without moving them, until deep brown on the bottom.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Turn each patty once with a spatula.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Cook for 4 to 5 more minutes.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Push the thermometer sideways into the middle of a patty. It must read at least 74°C. If it reads less, cook 1 more minute and check again.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: In the last minute, put one slice of cheese on each patty.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Cover the pans with a lid or foil until the cheese melts.
steps.section: COOK THE BURGERS (2 pans, 3 patties in each)

steps.text: Lay one cabbage leaf flat, with the thick end toward you.
Put a burger on the thick end of the leaf.
Put 1 onion round, 1 slice of tomato and 2 or 3 pickle slices on the burger.
Fold the thick end of the leaf up over the burger.
Fold one side of the leaf over the burger.
Roll the burger toward the other end of the leaf, until it is fully wrapped. Leave it seam side down.
Repeat with the other 5 burgers.
Put the wraps on a platter. Put the sauce in a bowl with a spoon next to them.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: each patty is brown and juicy and reads 74°C, the cheese is melted, and the leaf is soft, bright green and not torn.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not skip the boiling water. Raw cabbage is stiff and breaks when you fold it.
⚠️ Ground beef must reach 74°C in the middle. Use the thermometer.
cheeseburger_cabbage_wraps.description_ru: Котлета с сыром, луком и огурцом в капустном листе, соус

pizza_frittata.title: PIZZA FRITTATA
pizza_frittata.description: Baked in the oven in a dish, cut into squares.
pizza_frittata.time_line: ⏱ 50 minutes (pan 1 and the oven). Start at T minus 55 min.

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 35 ml (2 tablespoons for the pan and 1 teaspoon for the dish)
ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.note: (2 tablespoons for the pan and 1 teaspoon for the dish)

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, large pan, big bowl, whisk or fork, thermometer

steps.text: Put the oven shelf in the middle. Turn the oven on to 200°C.
Rub the baking dish with 1 teaspoon of olive oil.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes of about 5 mm.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the mozzarella on the large holes of the grater.
Cut the salami into thin rounds, about 3 mm.
Crack the 12 eggs into a big bowl.
Add the milk, the oregano, 1 teaspoon of salt, the pepper and the tomato sauce.
Whisk with a fork for 30 seconds, until the colour is even.
Heat 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of olive oil in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the onion and the garlic. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Add the spinach. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until it is wilted.
Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of salt over the spinach and stir.
Spread the vegetables evenly on the bottom of the baking dish.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables.
Scatter the mozzarella and the salami on top.
Put the dish in the middle of the hot oven.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Do not open the oven in the first 20 minutes.
Shake the dish gently. The middle must not wobble.
Push the thermometer into the middle. It must read at least 72°C. If it wobbles or reads less, bake 5 more minutes and check again.
Take the dish out and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Cut it into 6 big squares (3 columns, 2 rows) and put them on a platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: puffed up and golden at the edges, set in the middle, the cheese is melted, and the thermometer reads 72°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Opening the oven early makes the frittata fall.
⚠️ If the salami starts to burn, cover the dish with foil.
pizza_frittata.description_ru: Запечённые яйца с томатным соусом, шпинатом, моцареллой и салями

loaded_cauliflower_breakfast_bake.title: LOADED CAULIFLOWER BREAKFAST BAKE
loaded_cauliflower_breakfast_bake.description: Cauliflower, bacon, cheese and eggs baked in a dish, cut into squares.
loaded_cauliflower_breakfast_bake.time_line: ⏱ 65 minutes (pan 1 and the oven). Start at T minus 70 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 200 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 1 teaspoon, for the dish
ingredients.name: Olive oil

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, box grater, large pan, big bowl, thermometer, paper towels

steps.text: Put the oven shelf in the middle. Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Rub the baking dish with the olive oil.
Cut the cauliflower head into 4 pieces.
Grate the cauliflower on the large holes of the grater, straight into the baking dish.
If the grated cauliflower looks wet, press it between sheets of paper towel.
Spread the cauliflower evenly in the dish and press it down lightly.
Cut the bacon into strips about 1 cm wide.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Peel the red onion and chop it into small cubes of about 5 mm.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Put the bacon in the cold pan. Turn the heat to medium.
Fry for 8 minutes, stirring every minute, until crispy.
Move the bacon to a plate lined with paper towel.
Crack the eggs into a big bowl.
Add the milk, the garlic, the paprika, the salt and the pepper.
Whisk with a fork for 30 seconds, until the colour is even.
Sprinkle the cheese over the cauliflower in the dish.
Scatter the bacon over the cheese.
Scatter the red onion over the bacon.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over everything.
Put the dish in the middle of the hot oven.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
Shake the dish gently. The middle must not wobble, and the top must be golden.
Push the thermometer into the middle. It must read at least 72°C. If it reads less, bake 5 more minutes and check again.
Take the dish out and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Cut it into 6 big squares and put them on a platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: golden on top, set in the middle, and the thermometer reads 72°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not skip step 5. Wet cauliflower makes the bake watery.
⚠️ Bacon burns fast. Stir it often and take it off as soon as it is crispy.
loaded_cauliflower_breakfast_bake.title_ru: Запеканка из цветной капусты с беконом
loaded_cauliflower_breakfast_bake.description_ru: Цветная капуста, бекон, чеддер и яйца в духовке

sausage_and_broccoli_egg_casserole.title: SAUSAGE AND BROCCOLI EGG CASSEROLE
sausage_and_broccoli_egg_casserole.description: Sausage, broccoli and cheese baked in cream and eggs, cut into squares.
sausage_and_broccoli_egg_casserole.time_line: ⏱ 80 minutes (pan 1, pot and the oven). Start at T minus 85 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 115 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 35 ml (2 tablespoons for the pan and 1 teaspoon for the dish)
ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.note: (2 tablespoons for the pan and 1 teaspoon for the dish)

ingredients.text: Salt: 1 tablespoon (for the water) + 1 1/4 teaspoons (for the eggs)
ingredients.name: Salt

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, large pan, pot, colander, clean kitchen towel, big bowl, thermometer

steps.text: Put the oven shelf in the middle. Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Rub the baking dish with 1 teaspoon of olive oil.
Cut the sausages into coins about 1 cm thick.
Cut the broccoli into small florets of 2 to 3 cm.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Heat 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of olive oil in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the sausage coins.
Fry for 8 minutes, stirring every minute, until golden.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Move everything to a large bowl.
Pour 3 litres of water into the pot and bring it to a boil.
Add 1 tablespoon (18 g) of salt.
Add the broccoli and boil for 3 minutes.
Pour the broccoli into the colander and rinse with cold water for 30 seconds.
Wrap the broccoli in the clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Chop the broccoli into pieces of about 1 cm.
Add the broccoli to the bowl with the sausages and mix.
Spread the sausage and broccoli mix evenly in the baking dish.
Sprinkle the cheese over the top.
Crack the eggs into a big bowl.
Add the cream, 1 1/4 teaspoons of salt and the pepper.
Whisk with a fork for 30 seconds, until the colour is even.
Pour the egg mixture over the dish.
Put the dish in the middle of the hot oven.
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes.
Shake the dish gently. The middle must not wobble.
Push the thermometer into the middle. It must read at least 72°C. If it reads less, bake 5 more minutes and check again.
Take the dish out and let it rest for 15 minutes. It firms up while it rests.
Cut it into 6 big squares and put them on a platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: golden on top, set in the middle, and the thermometer reads 72°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not skip the squeezing in step 16. Wet broccoli makes the casserole watery.
⚠️ Cut it only after the 15 minute rest, or it falls apart.
sausage_and_broccoli_egg_casserole.title_ru: Яичная запеканка с колбасой и брокколи
sausage_and_broccoli_egg_casserole.description_ru: Колбаски, брокколи и сыр, залитые яйцами со сливками

pulled_pork_eggs_benedict.title: PULLED PORK EGGS BENEDICT
pulled_pork_eggs_benedict.description: A long dish. The pork cooks slowly in the oven, the eggs are poached at the end.
pulled_pork_eggs_benedict.time_line: ⏱ About 4 hours (oven, 1 large pot, 1 large pan, 1 bowl). Start at T minus 250 min.

ingredients.text: Eggs: 12 (for poaching) + 4 egg yolks (for the sauce)
ingredients.name: Eggs

equipment: Baking dish with foil, thermometer, large pot, large pan, heatproof bowl, whisk, slotted spoon, 2 forks

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 150°C.
Pat the pork dry with paper towel. Cut it into 4 big pieces.
Mix 2 teaspoons of salt, the pepper and the paprika in a small bowl.
Rub the olive oil and then the spice mix over all the pork pieces.
Put the pork in a baking dish. Cover the dish tightly with foil.
Bake for 3 hours.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It must read at least 90°C and the meat must fall apart when pressed with a fork.
If it is harder, cover again and bake 30 more minutes, then check again.
Take the dish out. Let it rest covered for 15 minutes.
Pull the meat apart into shreds with two forks. Mix it with the juice from the dish.
Cover with foil and keep it warm in the switched-off oven.
Melt the butter in a small pot on low heat. Keep it warm.
Half-fill a pot with water and bring it to a gentle simmer. Do not boil hard.
Put the 4 egg yolks, the lime juice and 1 tablespoon of warm water in a heatproof bowl.
Put the bowl on top of the pot, not touching the water.
Whisk all the time for 2 to 3 minutes, until the yolks are pale and thick.
Take the bowl off the heat.
Whisk in the warm butter a little at a time, a teaspoon at first, then faster.
Whisk in 1 teaspoon of salt.
Cover the bowl and put it on a warm spot, not on the stove.
Fill the large pan 8 cm deep with water. Add the vinegar. Bring to a gentle simmer.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Crack each egg into a small cup.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Stir the water in a circle to make a slow whirlpool.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Slide 4 eggs into the water, one at a time, gently.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Cook for 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon onto a plate lined with paper towel.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Repeat steps 23 to 26 until all 12 eggs are done.
steps.section: POACHED EGGS (at T minus 20 min, 3 batches of 4 eggs)

steps.text: Split the muffins and toast all halves.
Put 2 halves on each plate.
Put a heap of pulled pork on each half.
Put a poached egg on the pork.
Spoon the sauce over each egg.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the pork is tender and shreds easily, the egg white is set and the yolk runs when cut, and the sauce is smooth and yellow.
warnings: ⚠️ The sauce splits if it gets too hot. If it looks curdled, whisk in 1 teaspoon of warm water.
⚠️ Eggs go cold fast. Poach them last and serve at once.
⚠️ Do not add salt to the poaching water.
pulled_pork_eggs_benedict.description_ru: Томлёная свинина, яйцо пашот и голландский соус на безглютеновых маффинах

bacon_egg_and_cheese_breakfast_burritos.title: BACON, EGG AND CHEESE BREAKFAST BURRITOS
bacon_egg_and_cheese_breakfast_burritos.time_line: ⏱ 55 minutes (oven, pan 1, pan 2). Start at T minus 60 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 270 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, 2 pans, whisk, foil, paper towels

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Rub the baking dish with a little butter.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the cream, the salt and the pepper. Whisk for 20 seconds.
Lay 5 bacon slices in pan 1, one layer, cold pan. Turn the heat to medium.
Fry for 4 to 5 minutes, turn, fry 3 to 4 more minutes until crispy.
Move the bacon to paper towel. Repeat until all the bacon is done.
Crumble the cooled bacon into small pieces.
Melt the butter in pan 2 on LOW heat.
Pour in all the eggs. Wait 20 seconds.
Stir slowly for 5 to 6 minutes until soft and creamy.
Take the pan off the heat while the eggs are still a little wet. They finish cooking in the heat.
Warm each flatbread for 10 seconds in a dry pan so it bends without breaking.
Put the flatbread flat. Spoon the eggs down the middle, about 1/6 of the eggs.
Put bacon and 30 g of cheese on the eggs.
Fold the sides in, then roll the flatbread tight.
Put the burrito seam side down in the baking dish. Repeat for all 6.
Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and some bacon on top.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cheese on top is melted and golden, and the burritos are hot all the way through.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not overcook the eggs in step 11. They bake again in the oven.
⚠️ Make sure the flatbreads are gluten-free.
bacon_egg_and_cheese_breakfast_burritos.title_ru: Буррито с беконом, яйцом и сыром
bacon_egg_and_cheese_breakfast_burritos.description_ru: Скрэмбл, хрустящий бекон и сыр в безглютеновой лепёшке

cheese_frico_fried_egg_tostadas.title: CHEESE FRICO FRIED EGG TOSTADAS
cheese_frico_fried_egg_tostadas.description: A light dish. Crispy cheese discs with a fried egg and fresh tomato salsa.
cheese_frico_fried_egg_tostadas.time_line: ⏱ 35 minutes (pan 1 and pan 2). Start at T minus 40 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 180 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: 2 small non-stick pans with lids (or foil), baking tray, baking paper, spatula

steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into small cubes of about 5 mm. Cut the red onion into small cubes.
Mix the tomatoes, onion, lime juice, chili flakes and 1/2 teaspoon of salt in a bowl.
Cover the bowl and put it in the fridge.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Cover a baking tray with baking paper.
Heat the small non-stick pan on medium heat for 1 minute. Do not add oil.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Sprinkle 30 g of cheese in an even round layer, about 12 cm wide.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Cook for 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Crack 1 egg into the middle of the cheese.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Sprinkle a tiny pinch of salt and pepper over the egg.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Cook for 2 minutes without touching it, until the egg white is half set and the cheese is deep golden.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Cover the pan and cook for 1 more minute, until the egg white is fully set.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Take the lid off. Cook 1 more minute, until the cheese is firm enough to lift.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Lift the disc with a spatula onto the baking tray. Let it harden for 2 minutes.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Repeat steps 7 to 14 for the other 5 discs. Use the second pan at the same time.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

steps.text: Put the discs on a platter. Spoon the cold salsa on each one.
steps.section: COOK (6 discs, 3 in each pan, one disc at a time)

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cheese is crisp and deep golden, the egg white is set and the yolk is soft, and the disc holds its shape when lifted.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not use oil. The cheese makes its own fat.
⚠️ If the cheese sticks, wait 1 more minute. It lifts off when it is crisp.
cheese_frico_fried_egg_tostadas.title_ru: Тостады с яйцом на сырной основе
cheese_frico_fried_egg_tostadas.description_ru: Хрустящий сырный диск с яйцом и свежей томатной сальсой

cream_cheese_pancakes_no_flour.title: CREAM CHEESE PANCAKES (no flour)
cream_cheese_pancakes_no_flour.description: Thin pancakes made of almond flour, cream cheese and eggs. 3 pancakes per portion.
cream_cheese_pancakes_no_flour.time_line: ⏱ 40 minutes (pan 1 and pan 2). Start at T minus 45 min.
equipment: 2 non-stick pans, whisk, big bowl, spatula

steps.text: Let the cream cheese stand for 20 minutes at room temperature so it is soft.
Grate the zest of 1 lime on the small holes of the grater. You need 2 teaspoons.
Crack the eggs into a big bowl.
Add the cream cheese, the almond flour, the lime zest and the vanilla.
Whisk for 1 to 2 minutes until the batter is smooth, with no lumps.
Heat both pans on medium-low heat for 1 minute.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Melt 1 teaspoon of butter in each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Pour 3 tablespoons of batter into the pan for each pancake. Put 3 pancakes in each pan.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Cook for 2 minutes, until golden underneath and the edges look set.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Flip each pancake with a spatula.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Cook for 2 more minutes.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Move the pancakes to a warm platter and cover with foil.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Repeat steps 7 to 12 until all the batter is used (about 18 pancakes).
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

steps.text: Serve with a small piece of butter on each stack.
steps.section: COOK (2 pans, 3 pancakes at a time in each pan)

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: golden on both sides, set in the middle, and they flip without breaking.
warnings: ⚠️ Keep the heat medium-low. High heat burns the outside and leaves the middle raw.
⚠️ The batter is thin and the pancakes are soft. They are not like normal pancakes. Flip them gently.
cream_cheese_pancakes_no_flour.description_ru: Тонкие панкейки из миндальной муки, крем-сыра и яиц

smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese_rolls.title: SMOKED SALMON AND CREAM CHEESE ROLLS
smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese_rolls.description: A light cold dish. Make it a few hours ahead.
smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese_rolls.time_line: ⏱ 30 minutes of work, then 2 hours in the fridge. Start at T minus 150 min.
equipment: Baking paper (greaseproof), cling film, sharp knife, rolling pin or a bottle, bowl

steps.text: Let the cream cheese stand for 20 minutes at room temperature so it is soft.
Cut the pickled cucumbers into very small cubes of about 3 mm.
Cut the red onion into very small cubes of about 3 mm.
Grate the zest of 1 lime on the small holes of the grater.
Mix the cream cheese, the cucumbers, the onion, the lime zest and the pepper in a bowl until smooth. Do not add salt.
Cut 2 sheets of baking paper, each about 40 cm long.
Put the salmon slices on one sheet, slightly overlapping, in a rectangle about 30 x 15 cm. Use half of the salmon for each roll.
Put the second sheet on top and press or roll with a rolling pin to flatten the salmon.
Remove the top sheet.
Spoon half of the cream cheese mix in a line down the middle of the salmon, about 4 cm wide.
Using the bottom paper, lift one long side of the salmon over the filling.
Keep rolling it into a tight log. Peel the paper away as you roll.
Wrap the roll in cling film and twist the ends.
Repeat for the second roll.
Put both rolls in the fridge for 2 hours.
Unwrap the rolls.
Cut each roll into rounds about 2 cm thick with a sharp knife, wiping the knife between cuts.
Put the rounds on a platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the rolls are firm, the cut rounds hold their shape, and the filling is pale with small green and purple pieces.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add salt. Salmon and cream cheese are already salty.
⚠️ Use a very sharp knife. A dull knife squashes the rolls.
smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese_rolls.title_ru: Рулеты с копчёным лососем и крем-сыром
smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese_rolls.description_ru: Холодные рулеты с солёными огурчиками и красным луком

shrimp_and_shirataki_noodle_stir_fry.title: SHRIMP AND SHIRATAKI NOODLE STIR-FRY
shrimp_and_shirataki_noodle_stir_fry.time_line: ⏱ 30 minutes (1 large pan, 2 batches). Start at T minus 35 min.

ingredients.text: Chicken stock cube: 1 (dissolved in 100 ml of hot water)
ingredients.name: Chicken stock cube

equipment: Large pan, colander, grater, tongs

steps.text: Open the noodle packs over the sink and pour them into a colander.
Rinse under cold water for 2 minutes. Shake off the water.
If the prawns are frozen, thaw them in the fridge overnight. Pat them dry with paper towel.
Peel the prawns if they have shells. Leave the tails on.
Cut the cabbage into thin strips about 5 mm wide.
Grate the carrots on the large holes of the grater.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely. Peel the onion and cut it into thin half-rings.
Dissolve the stock cube in 100 ml of hot water.
Mix the tamari and the coconut aminos in a small bowl.
Heat the pan on medium-high for 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add half of the onion and half of the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add half of the cabbage. Stir for 2 minutes.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Pour in half of the stock. Cook for 1 minute until the cabbage wilts.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add half of the carrots and stir for 30 seconds.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add half of the prawns. Stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until all the prawns are pink and curled.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add half of the noodles and half of the tamari mix.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Add 1/4 teaspoon of chili flakes and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper. Stir for 1 minute.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Move everything to a warm bowl and cover with foil.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Wipe the pan. Repeat steps 10 to 18 with the second half.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

steps.text: Mix both batches together.
steps.section: COOK (2 batches, each with half of the ingredients)

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the prawns are pink and firm (not grey and not rubbery), the cabbage is soft, and the noodles are hot and brown from the sauce.
warnings: ⚠️ Prawns cook in 2 to 3 minutes. Longer makes them rubbery.
⚠️ Do not add salt. Tamari and coconut aminos are salty.
shrimp_and_shirataki_noodle_stir_fry.description_ru: Обжарка с капустой и морковью, соус тамари, без мяса

chicken_tetrazzini_with_shirataki_noodle.title: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI WITH SHIRATAKI NOODLES
chicken_tetrazzini_with_shirataki_noodle.description: Chicken and noodles in a creamy cheese sauce, baked.
chicken_tetrazzini_with_shirataki_noodle.time_line: ⏱ 65 minutes (pot, 1 large pan, oven). Start at T minus 70 min.

ingredients.text: Shirataki noodles (fettuccine or angel hair): 700 g
ingredients.name: Shirataki noodles (fettuccine or angel hair)

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 170 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, large pan, pot, colander, thermometer, kitchen scissors

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 200°C. Rub the baking dish with a little olive oil.
Rinse the noodles in a colander under cold water for 2 minutes. Squeeze out the water.
Cut the noodles 5 or 6 times with scissors into short pieces. Put them in a bowl.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Cut the pepper into cubes of about 1 cm.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely. Grate the cheese.
Put the chicken in a pot and cover it with cold water.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down so it only bubbles gently.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the chicken out. Let it cool for 10 minutes.
Shred the chicken into thin pieces with two forks.
Heat the oil in the large pan on medium-high heat. Add the onion and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the pepper and garlic. Fry for 3 minutes, stirring.
In a cup, mix the arrowroot with 3 tablespoons of cold water until smooth.
Pour the milk and the 180 ml of water into the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the arrowroot mix. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick.
Add 120 g of the cheese. Stir until melted.
Add the pepper. Stir in the noodles and the chicken.
Pour everything into the baking dish. Sprinkle 50 g of cheese on top.
Bake for 15 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the top is golden, the sauce bubbles at the edges, and the noodles are hot.
warnings: ⚠️ The noodles release water. If the sauce is thin, bake 5 more minutes.
⚠️ Do not boil the sauce hard after adding the arrowroot. It turns slimy.
chicken_tetrazzini_with_shirataki_noodle.description_ru: Курица и лапша в сливочно-сырном соусе, запечённые

bacon_and_beef_stuffed_peppers.title: BACON AND BEEF STUFFED PEPPERS
bacon_and_beef_stuffed_peppers.time_line: ⏱ 75 minutes (large pot, oven). Start at T minus 80 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 240 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Large pot, 2 baking dishes, thermometer, paper towels

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Cut each pepper in half from top to bottom. Take out the seeds. Keep the stalks on.
Cut the bacon into strips of 1 cm. Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes.
Grate the cheese. Dissolve the stock cube in 300 ml of hot water.
Put the bacon in the large pot on medium heat. Fry for 8 minutes until crispy.
Move the bacon to paper towel.
Add the onion to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the beef. Break it into small pieces with a spoon.
Cook for 7 minutes, until no pink is left.
Add the paprika, oregano, salt and pepper. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and the stock.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until slightly thick.
Put the 16 pepper halves in the baking dishes, cut side up.
Fill each half with the meat mixture.
Sprinkle the cheese on top, then the bacon.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the peppers are soft.
Push the thermometer into the middle of a filling. It must read at least 74°C.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cheese is golden and bubbling, the peppers are soft when pressed with a fork, and the filling reads 74°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Fill the peppers in the dish, not in your hand. They are heavy and drip.
⚠️ If the peppers are still hard after 30 minutes, bake 10 more minutes.
bacon_and_beef_stuffed_peppers.description_ru: Перец с говяжьим фаршем в томатном соусе под сыром

beef_stroganoff_with_mushrooms.title: BEEF STROGANOFF WITH MUSHROOMS
beef_stroganoff_with_mushrooms.description: Ground beef and mushrooms in a creamy sauce.
beef_stroganoff_with_mushrooms.time_line: ⏱ 45 minutes (large pan, 3 batches of mushrooms). Start at T minus 50 min.
equipment: Large deep pan, spatula, bowls

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms with a damp paper towel. Cut them into slices about 5 mm thick.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Dissolve the stock cube in 400 ml of hot water.
Mix the sour cream, tamari, mustard and paprika in a bowl.
Heat the pan on medium-high for 2 minutes. Melt 20 g of butter.
Add the beef and sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Break the beef into small pieces. Cook for 7 minutes, stirring, until no pink is left.
Move the beef to a bowl. Wipe the pan.
Melt 13 g of butter in the pan on medium-high heat.
Add one third of the mushrooms in one layer.
Leave them 3 minutes without stirring. Stir, then cook 4 more minutes until golden and dry.
Move them to a bowl. Repeat steps 9 to 11 two more times.
Put all the mushrooms back in the pan. Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and the stock. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in the sour cream mix. Heat for 2 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Add the beef back. Stir for 2 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the sauce is thick and pale brown, the mushrooms are soft, and everything is hot but not boiling.
warnings: ⚠️ Boiling splits the sour cream. Keep the heat low after step 15.
⚠️ Do not crowd the mushrooms. Crowded mushrooms steam and turn grey.
beef_stroganoff_with_mushrooms.description_ru: Говядина и грибы в сметанном соусе

parmesan_crusted_chicken_with_tomato_and.title: PARMESAN-CRUSTED CHICKEN WITH TOMATO AND MOZZARELLA
parmesan_crusted_chicken_with_tomato_and.description: Chicken cutlets in a cheese crust (no flour), topped with tomato sauce and cheese.
parmesan_crusted_chicken_with_tomato_and.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (2 pans, oven). Start at T minus 65 min.
equipment: 2 baking trays, 2 large pans, 3 shallow bowls, tongs, thermometer, sharp knife

steps.text: Put the oven shelf in the middle. Turn the oven on to 200°C.
Grate the parmesan on the small holes of the grater. Grate the mozzarella on the large holes.
Lay a chicken breast flat. Hold the palm of your hand on top.
Cut it in half through the middle, parallel to the board, to make 2 thin cutlets.
Repeat with all 6 breasts. You have 12 cutlets.
Sprinkle the cutlets with the salt and pepper on both sides.
Crack the eggs in a bowl and beat with a fork.
Mix the parmesan, oregano and paprika in a second bowl.
Dip one cutlet in the egg, turn it to coat both sides.
Press it into the parmesan mix on both sides, pressing hard so the cheese sticks.
Put it on a plate. Repeat with all the cutlets.
Heat both pans on medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of oil to each.
steps.section: FRY (2 pans at the same time, in batches)

steps.text: Put 3 or 4 cutlets in each pan.
steps.section: FRY (2 pans at the same time, in batches)

steps.text: Fry for 2 to 3 minutes on the first side, until golden.
steps.section: FRY (2 pans at the same time, in batches)

steps.text: Turn and fry 2 to 3 minutes more.
steps.section: FRY (2 pans at the same time, in batches)

steps.text: Move the cutlets to a baking tray. Add oil to the pan and repeat until all are fried.
steps.section: FRY (2 pans at the same time, in batches)

steps.text: Spoon 1 tablespoon of tomato sauce on each cutlet.
Put the mozzarella on top.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Push the thermometer into the thickest cutlet. It must read at least 74°C.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the crust is golden, the cheese is melted and bubbling, and the chicken reads 74°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Press the parmesan firmly on the chicken, or the crust falls off in the pan.
⚠️ Keep the heat on medium. Parmesan burns fast and tastes bitter.
parmesan_crusted_chicken_with_tomato_and.description_ru: Котлеты из грудки в сыре с томатом и моцареллой

crispy_oven_chicken_wings_with_smoky_dip.title: CRISPY OVEN CHICKEN WINGS WITH SMOKY DIP
crispy_oven_chicken_wings_with_smoky_dip.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (oven, 2 baking trays). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Arrowroot: 1 1/2 tablespoons (this makes the skin crisp)
ingredients.name: Arrowroot

ingredients.text: For the dip: mayonnaise 100 g (6 tablespoons), paprika 1 teaspoon, chili flakes 1/4 teaspoon, lime juice 1 tablespoon
ingredients.name: For the dip
ingredients.note: mayonnaise 100 g (6 tablespoons), paprika 1 teaspoon, chili flakes 1/4 teaspoon, lime juice 1 tablespoon

equipment: 2 baking trays, foil, paper towels, thermometer, big bowl

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 220°C. Put the oven shelves in the top and the middle.
Cover the 2 baking trays with foil.
Pat every wing piece completely dry with paper towel. Dry wings get crispy, wet wings do not.
Put the wings in a big bowl.
Add the oil and toss until every piece is coated.
Mix the arrowroot, the paprika, the salt and the pepper in a small bowl.
Sprinkle it over the wings and toss until they are evenly coated.
Mix the dip in a small bowl: mayonnaise, paprika, chili flakes and lime juice. Cover it and put it in the fridge.
Lay the wings on the trays in one layer, skin side up, with space between them.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Swap the trays' places. Turn each wing over with tongs.
Bake for 15 to 20 more minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
Push the thermometer into the thickest wing, not touching the bone. It must read at least 80°C.
Take the trays out and let the wings rest for 5 minutes.
Put the wings on a platter. Put the dip in a small bowl next to them.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the skin is deep golden and crisp, the thermometer shows 80°C or more, and the juice is clear.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not crowd the trays. Crowded wings steam and stay soft.
⚠️ Wash your hands and the board after touching raw chicken.
crispy_oven_chicken_wings_with_smoky_dip.description_ru: Хрустящие крылья с острым майонезным соусом

cheese_meatballs_in_tomato_sauce.title: CHEESE MEATBALLS IN TOMATO SAUCE
cheese_meatballs_in_tomato_sauce.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (large pan, 2 batches). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 90 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: Garlic: 15 g (3 cloves: 1 for the meatballs, 2 for the sauce)
ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.note: (3 cloves: 1 for the meatballs, 2 for the sauce)

equipment: Large deep pan with a lid, big bowl, thermometer, paper towels

steps.text: Grate the cheddar and the parmesan on the small holes of the grater.
Peel the garlic. Chop 1 clove finely for the meatballs. Chop 2 cloves for the sauce.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes.
Put the beef, the 1 clove of garlic, the cheeses, the eggs, 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and 3/4 teaspoon of pepper in a big bowl.
Mix with your hands for 1 minute, until just combined. Do not squeeze it hard.
Wet your hands with water. Divide the meat into 24 equal balls (about 50 g each).
Heat the pan on medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil.
Put 12 meatballs in the pan with space between them.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, turning with tongs every 2 minutes, until golden on all sides.
Move them to a plate lined with paper towel.
Wipe the pan. Repeat steps 7 to 10 with the second 12 meatballs.
In the same pan, heat the last tablespoon (15 ml) of oil on medium heat.
Add the onion. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the 2 cloves of garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, the oregano, 3/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Put all the meatballs back in the sauce.
Cover with the lid. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the middle of a meatball. It must read at least 74°C.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the sauce is thick, the meatballs are firm and brown, and the thermometer reads 74°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not mix the meat too long. Overmixed meatballs are hard.
⚠️ If the sauce is thin after 15 minutes, take the lid off and simmer 5 more minutes.
cheese_meatballs_in_tomato_sauce.description_ru: Говяжьи шарики с чеддером и пармезаном

cheese_taco_cups_with_beef.title: CHEESE TACO CUPS WITH BEEF
cheese_taco_cups_with_beef.description: Crispy cheese cups filled with spiced beef. 2 cups per portion.
cheese_taco_cups_with_beef.time_line: ⏱ 70 minutes (oven, large pan). Start at T minus 75 min. This dish needs a muffin tin.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 240 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Muffin tin (12 holes), baking paper, 2 baking trays, large pan, thermometer, spoon

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 190°C.
Cover the baking trays with baking paper.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Cut the avocado into cubes of 1 cm and the tomatoes into cubes of 1 cm. Keep them in two bowls.
Put 8 small heaps of cheese on each tray (1 tablespoon, 15 g each), far apart, so they can spread.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Bake for 6 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the edges turn golden.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Let the cheese cool on the tray for 1 minute until it can be lifted.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Turn the muffin tin upside down. Lift each cheese disc with a spatula and drape it over a hole in the tin.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Let the cups cool for 10 minutes until hard.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Bake the second tray the same way and shape the rest of the cups.
steps.section: MAKE THE CHEESE CUPS (16 cups, 8 per tray)

steps.text: Heat the oil in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the onion. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the beef. Break it into small pieces.
Add the paprika, the oregano, the salt and the pepper.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until no pink is left.
Push the thermometer into the beef. It must read at least 74°C.
Tilt the pan and spoon out the fat into a bowl. Throw it in the bin, not down the sink.
Put the 16 cups on a platter.
Fill each cup with beef just before serving.
Put the avocado, the tomatoes and the sour cream in three bowls next to the platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cups are hard and crisp, golden, and hold the filling without breaking.
warnings: ⚠️ Fill the cups only when you serve. They go soft in 10 minutes.
⚠️ If a cup is soft, bake it again on the tray for 1 minute.
cheese_taco_cups_with_beef.description_ru: Хрустящие сырные чашечки с пряным фаршем, авокадо и сметаной

bacon_wrapped_meatloaf_with_cheese.title: BACON-WRAPPED MEATLOAF WITH CHEESE
bacon_wrapped_meatloaf_with_cheese.time_line: ⏱ 90 minutes (large pan, oven). Start at T minus 95 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 120 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, large pan, big bowl, thermometer, foil

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 190°C. Rub the baking dish with a little oil.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Cut the celery into small cubes.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the cheddar and the parmesan.
Heat 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil in the pan on medium heat.
Add the onion and the celery. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, the oregano and the paprika. Stir for 1 minute.
Let the mixture cool for 10 minutes.
Put the beef, the cooled vegetables, the cheeses, the eggs, the tamari, the salt and the pepper in a big bowl.
Mix with your hands for 1 minute, until just combined.
Shape the meat into one big loaf in the baking dish, about 8 cm high and 12 cm wide.
Lay the bacon slices across the loaf, side by side.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.
If the bacon darkens too fast, cover the dish with foil.
Push the thermometer into the middle of the loaf. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the dish out. Let the loaf rest for 10 minutes.
Cut the loaf into 8 thick slices.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the bacon is crisp and deep golden, the thermometer reads 74°C or more, and the juice is clear with no pink.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not cut the loaf before the 10 minutes rest. It falls apart.
⚠️ If a lot of fat gathers in the dish, spoon it out before slicing.
bacon_wrapped_meatloaf_with_cheese.title_ru: Мясной рулет с беконом и сыром
bacon_wrapped_meatloaf_with_cheese.description_ru: Запечённый говяжий рулет под хрустящим беконом

stuffed_cabbage_rolls_in_tomato_sauce.title: STUFFED CABBAGE ROLLS IN TOMATO SAUCE
stuffed_cabbage_rolls_in_tomato_sauce.time_line: ⏱ 100 minutes (pot, large pan, oven). Start at T minus 105 min.

ingredients.text: Cabbage: 1 large head (you need 16 whole leaves)
ingredients.name: Cabbage

equipment: Large pot, large deep pan, baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, grater, thermometer, foil

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Cut the hard white core out of the cabbage. Peel off 16 whole leaves, without tearing them.
Grate the cauliflower on the large holes of the grater. This is the "rice".
Peel the onion and cut it into very small cubes.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Using tongs, put 3 or 4 leaves in the boiling water for 1 minute, until soft.
Lift them out onto a plate. Repeat until all 16 leaves are soft.
With a knife, shave down the thick white rib at the bottom of each leaf.
Heat the oil in the large deep pan on medium heat.
Add the tomato sauce, the vinegar, the oregano and the chili flakes.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 15 minutes.
Put the beef, the pork, the cauliflower, the onion, 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/2 teaspoon of pepper and 4 tablespoons of the sauce in a big bowl.
Mix with your hands for 1 minute, until just combined.
Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of the baking dish.
Lay one leaf flat, thick end toward you. Put about 3 tablespoons (60 g) of filling on the thick end.
Fold the thick end over the filling. Fold both sides in. Roll up tightly.
Put the roll in the dish, seam side down. Repeat for all 16 rolls, packing them close together.
Pour the rest of the sauce over the rolls.
Cover the dish tightly with foil.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the middle of a roll. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the foil off and bake for 10 more minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cabbage is very soft, the sauce is bubbling, and the filling reads 74°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not overfill the leaves. They split when you roll them.
⚠️ Keep the foil tight in step 20. The steam makes the rolls soft.
stuffed_cabbage_rolls_in_tomato_sauce.description_ru: Говядина со свининой и цветной капустой вместо риса

pork_chops_in_creamy_mushroom_and_parmes.title: PORK CHOPS IN CREAMY MUSHROOM AND PARMESAN SAUCE
pork_chops_in_creamy_mushroom_and_parmes.time_line: ⏱ 55 minutes (2 large pans). Start at T minus 60 min.

ingredients.text: Boneless pork chops: 1400 g (8 chops of 175 g)
ingredients.name: Boneless pork chops

equipment: 2 large pans with lids, tongs, thermometer, foil, plate

steps.text: Take the chops out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking.
Wipe the mushrooms with a damp paper towel and cut them into slices about 5 mm thick.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the parmesan on the small holes of the grater.
Pat the chops dry. Sprinkle them with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and 3/4 teaspoon of pepper on both sides.
Heat both pans on medium-high for 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil to each.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Put 4 chops in each pan with space between them.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Cook for 5 minutes on the first side without moving them.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Turn the chops with tongs. Cook for 5 minutes more.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Push the thermometer sideways into the thickest chop. It must read at least 70°C.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Move the chops to a plate and cover with foil. Keep the pans, with the juices.
steps.section: COOK THE CHOPS (pan 1 and pan 2, 4 chops in each)

steps.text: Pour the juices from pan 2 into pan 1. Wipe pan 2 and put it away.
Add 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of oil to pan 1 on medium heat.
Add the mushrooms. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the cream, the parmesan, the oregano, the chili flakes, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Add the spinach in handfuls. Stir for 2 minutes until it is wilted.
Put the chops back into the sauce. Cover the pan and heat for 5 minutes on low.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the chops read 70°C or more, they are golden with a little pink-white juice, and the sauce is thick and creamy.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil the cream sauce hard. It can split.
⚠️ Do not cook the chops past 75°C. Pork turns dry and tough.
pork_chops_in_creamy_mushroom_and_parmes.description_ru: Отбивные с шампиньонами, пармезаном и шпинатом

beef_and_mushroom_stew.title: BEEF AND MUSHROOM STEW
beef_and_mushroom_stew.description: A slow dish. It cooks gently for 1.5 hours.
beef_and_mushroom_stew.time_line: ⏱ About 2 hours 15 minutes (large pot with a lid). Start at T minus 140 min.
equipment: Large heavy pot with a lid, slotted spoon, plate

steps.text: Pat the beef dry with paper towel. Cut it into cubes of about 3 cm.
Sprinkle the beef with 1 teaspoon of salt and the pepper.
Cut the mushrooms into quarters.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the carrots and cut them into rounds of 1 cm.
Cut the celery into slices of 1 cm. Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Dissolve the 2 stock cubes in 1800 ml of hot water.
Heat 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil in the pot on medium-high heat.
Put one third of the beef in the pot in one layer.
Cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown. Do not crowd the pot.
Move the beef to a plate. Repeat steps 7 to 9 with the other two thirds.
Add the mushrooms to the same pot. Cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the onion, carrots and celery. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste. Stir for 1 minute until the vegetables are coated.
Add the beef and the stock to the pot. Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently.
Put the lid on, leaving a small gap.
Cook for 1 1/2 hours.
Test a piece of beef with a fork.
If the beef is still hard, cook 20 more minutes and test again.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: a fork goes in easily and the beef nearly falls apart, and the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil the stew hard. It makes the beef tough.
⚠️ If the stew is too thin at the end, take the lid off and simmer 15 more minutes.
beef_and_mushroom_stew.description_ru: Томлёная говядина с овощами и грибами

bacon_chicken_thighs_in_garlic_cream_sau.title: BACON CHICKEN THIGHS IN GARLIC CREAM SAUCE
bacon_chicken_thighs_in_garlic_cream_sau.time_line: ⏱ 70 minutes (2 large pans with lids). Start at T minus 75 min.

ingredients.text: Chicken thighs (bone-in, with skin): 1400 g (about 8 thighs)
ingredients.name: Chicken thighs (bone-in, with skin)

ingredients.text: Chicken stock cube: 1 (dissolved in 300 ml of hot water)
ingredients.name: Chicken stock cube

equipment: 2 large pans with lids, tongs, thermometer, paper towels

steps.text: Cut the bacon into strips of 1 cm.
Peel the red onion and cut it into small cubes. Cut the mushrooms into slices of 5 mm.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely. Grate the parmesan on the small holes.
Dissolve the stock cube in 300 ml of hot water. Squeeze 2 tablespoons of lime juice.
Pat the thighs dry. Sprinkle them with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and 3/4 teaspoon of pepper on both sides.
Put the bacon in pan 1 on medium heat. Fry for 8 minutes until crispy. Move the bacon to paper towel.
Leave about 2 tablespoons of bacon fat in pan 1. Pour the rest into a bowl.
Heat pan 2 on medium-high with 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat.
Put 4 thighs in each pan, skin side down. Cook for 5 minutes without moving, until golden.
Turn the thighs. Cook for 5 minutes more.
Move the thighs to a plate. Pour the juices from pan 2 into pan 1. Put pan 2 away.
Add the onion to pan 1 on medium heat. Cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the mushrooms and 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, the cream, the parmesan and the lime juice.
Bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Put the thighs back in the pan, skin side up, so the skin stays above the sauce.
Cover the pan. Cook on low for 20 to 25 minutes.
Push the thermometer sideways into the thickest thigh, not touching the bone. It must read at least 74°C.
If it reads less, cook 5 more minutes and check again.
Scatter the bacon over the top just before serving.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the thermometer reads 74°C or more, the juice is clear, and the sauce is thick, creamy and pale brown.
warnings: ⚠️ Keep the sauce at a gentle simmer. Hard boiling splits the cream.
⚠️ Add the lime juice in step 15 with the pan on low heat, not boiling.
bacon_chicken_thighs_in_garlic_cream_sau.title_ru: Куриные бёдра с беконом в чесночном соусе
bacon_chicken_thighs_in_garlic_cream_sau.description_ru: Бёдра в сливочном соусе с грибами и пармезаном

slow_cooked_oxtail_stew.title: SLOW-COOKED OXTAIL STEW
slow_cooked_oxtail_stew.description: A very long dish. The meat cooks for about 3 hours until it falls off the bone.
slow_cooked_oxtail_stew.time_line: ⏱ About 3 hours 40 minutes (large heavy pot with a lid). Start at T minus 220 min.

ingredients.text: Oxtail (cut into pieces of 5 cm): 2000 g
ingredients.name: Oxtail (cut into pieces of 5 cm)

equipment: Large heavy pot with a lid, large bowl, slotted spoon

steps.text: Pat the oxtail pieces dry with paper towel.
Sprinkle them with 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and the pepper.
Peel the onions and cut them into small cubes. Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Mix the arrowroot with 4 tablespoons of cold water in a cup until smooth.
Heat the oil in the pot on medium-high heat.
Put about a third of the oxtail pieces in the pot in one layer.
Cook for 3 minutes on each side until deep golden brown.
Move the pieces to a big bowl. Repeat until all the pieces are browned.
Add half of the onion to the pot. Cook for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and the tomato paste. Stir for 3 minutes until the paste darkens.
Stir the arrowroot mix again and pour it in. Stir for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat. Put the oxtail back in.
Add the water, the tamari, the chili flakes and the rest of the onion.
Put the pot back on the heat and bring to a boil. Then turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently.
Put the lid on, leaving a small gap.
Cook for 3 hours. Stir gently every 30 minutes.
Test a piece of oxtail with a fork.
If the meat is still firm, cook 30 more minutes and test again.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt, stir and serve.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the meat pulls off the bone very easily and the sauce is thick and dark.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil hard. A hard boil makes the meat tough.
⚠️ If the sauce gets too thick, add 100 ml of hot water and stir.
⚠️ The pot will be heavy. Use two hands and oven gloves.
slow_cooked_oxtail_stew.description_ru: Долго томлёное мясо на кости, очень мягкое

garlic_butter_beef_steak_slices.title: GARLIC BUTTER BEEF STEAK SLICES
garlic_butter_beef_steak_slices.description: Marinated beef slices seared fast and finished in garlic butter.
garlic_butter_beef_steak_slices.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (large heavy pan). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 90 ml (6 tablespoons, for the marinade)
ingredients.name: Olive oil

ingredients.text: Vegetable oil: 45 ml (1 tablespoon per batch)
ingredients.name: Vegetable oil

equipment: Sharp knife, cutting board, big bowl, cling film, large heavy pan, tongs, foil, platter

steps.text: Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before you start.
Pat the steak dry with paper towel. Look for the fine lines in the meat. You will cut ACROSS them.
Cut the steak across the lines into slices about 1 cm thick. Cut long slices in half.
Peel the garlic. Grate 1 clove into a big bowl. Crush and chop the other 3 cloves and keep them in a cup.
Add the olive oil, the vinegar, the oregano and the chili flakes to the bowl. Mix.
Add the slices and turn them until all are coated.
Cover the bowl and leave it at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Lift the slices out of the marinade and pat them very dry with paper towel.
Sprinkle the slices with the salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat the pan on high for 3 minutes.
Flick a drop of water in. It must sizzle and disappear at once.
Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of vegetable oil and swirl.
Lay about 8 slices in the pan in one layer, not touching each other.
Fry for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes on the first side. Do not move them.
Turn each slice with tongs.
Fry for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on the second side.
Move the slices to a plate and cover with foil.
Repeat steps 12 to 17 until all the slices are cooked.
After the last batch, turn the heat to medium-low.
Add the butter and the chopped garlic. Stir for 30 seconds until the butter melts and smells of garlic.
Put all the slices on a platter and pour the garlic butter over them.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the slices are brown outside and still pink inside. Cut the thickest slice open to check.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not crowd the pan. Crowded slices steam and turn grey.
⚠️ Thin slices cook in about 3 minutes. Do not walk away from the pan.
⚠️ Garlic burns fast. Keep it in the pan for 30 seconds at most.

shchi_cabbage_soup_with_beef.title: SHCHI (cabbage soup) WITH BEEF
shchi_cabbage_soup_with_beef.time_line: ⏱ 100 minutes (large pot, 1 pan). Start at T minus 105 min.
equipment: Large pot, large pan, grater, slotted spoon, press or knife

steps.text: Cut the beef into pieces of about 3 cm.
Cut the cabbage into thin strips of about 5 mm.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the carrots.
Grate the carrots on the small holes of the grater.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Put the beef in the large pot and pour in 2800 ml of cold water.
Put the pot on high heat and bring to a boil.
Skim the grey foam off the top with a slotted spoon. Keep skimming for about 5 minutes.
Turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently. Put the lid on.
Cook for 1 hour, then test a piece of beef with a fork. It must be soft.
If it is still hard, cook 15 more minutes and test again.
Melt the butter in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the onion. Fry for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the carrots. Fry for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste. Stir for 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage to the pot with the beef. Bring back to a boil. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the fried vegetables to the pot. Stir. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, the bay leaves, 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and the pepper. Stir.
Turn off the heat. Cover the pot and leave it for 15 minutes.
Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the beef is soft, the cabbage is tender but not mushy, and the broth is golden-red.
warnings: ⚠️ Take the bay leaves out before serving.
⚠️ Do not add all the salt at the start. The broth reduces.
shchi_cabbage_soup_with_beef.description_ru: Классические щи со свежей капустой на говяжьем бульоне

lenten_shchi_with_fresh_cabbage_wednesda.title: LENTEN SHCHI WITH FRESH CABBAGE (Wednesday, no meat)
lenten_shchi_with_fresh_cabbage_wednesda.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (large pot). Start at T minus 65 min.
equipment: Large pot, grater, slotted spoon

steps.text: Peel the onion and the potatoes. Cut the onion and the potatoes into cubes of about 1.5 cm.
Peel the carrots. Grate them on the small holes of the grater.
Cut the cabbage into thin strips of about 5 mm.
Peel the garlic, cut it in half and take out the green middle. Chop it finely.
Melt the butter in the large pot on medium heat.
Add the onion, the garlic and the carrots. Fry for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring, until golden.
Add the potatoes.
Pour in 3000 ml of water.
Bring to a boil. Add 2 teaspoons of salt, the peppercorns and the bay leaves.
Turn the heat to medium. Cook for 20 minutes.
Test a potato with a fork. It must be soft.
Add the cabbage.
Cook for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the cabbage is tender.
Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again.
Take out the bay leaves.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the potatoes are soft, the cabbage is tender, and the broth is golden.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not cook the cabbage longer than 15 minutes. It turns grey and bitter.
⚠️ Serve hot. You can serve it with a spoonful of sour cream.
lenten_shchi_with_fresh_cabbage_wednesda.description_ru: Щи с капустой и картошкой без мяса

tomato_lentil_soup_with_mushrooms.title: TOMATO LENTIL SOUP WITH MUSHROOMS
tomato_lentil_soup_with_mushrooms.time_line: ⏱ 80 minutes (large pot, 1 pan). Start at T minus 85 min.
equipment: Large pot, large pan, grater, colander, slotted spoon

steps.text: Rinse the lentils in a colander under cold water 3 times.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the garlic.
Peel the carrots. Grate them on the large holes.
Cut the mushrooms into small cubes of about 5 mm.
Cut each tomato into 4 pieces. Grate the pieces on the large holes of the grater, down to the skin. Throw the skin away.
Put the lentils in the large pot with 2000 ml of cold water.
Bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low and put the lid on.
Cook for 40 to 50 minutes, until the lentils are soft. Skim off any foam.
Melt the butter in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the onion and the whole garlic cloves. Fry for 3 minutes.
Add the carrots. Fry for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms. Fry for 5 to 7 minutes until the water has gone.
Add the grated tomatoes and the tomato sauce. Stir. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes until thick.
Add the vegetables to the pot with the lentils. Stir.
Add the oregano, 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and the pepper.
Cook for 10 minutes on low heat, stirring now and then.
Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the lentils are soft and the soup is thick and red-orange.
warnings: ⚠️ Salt the lentils only at the end. Salt early makes them hard.
⚠️ If the soup is too thick, add 200 ml of hot water.
tomato_lentil_soup_with_mushrooms.title_ru: Томатный суп с чечевицей и грибами
tomato_lentil_soup_with_mushrooms.description_ru: Густой суп из чечевицы, помидоров и грибов

chicken_soup_with_shirataki_noodles.title: CHICKEN SOUP WITH SHIRATAKI NOODLES
chicken_soup_with_shirataki_noodles.time_line: ⏱ 55 minutes (large pot, 1 pan). Start at T minus 60 min.
equipment: Large pot, large pan, colander, thermometer, slotted spoon

steps.text: Rinse the chicken under cold water.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the carrots.
Cut the carrots and the pepper into cubes of about 1 cm.
Rinse the noodles in a colander under cold water for 2 minutes. Cut them 3 times with scissors into shorter pieces.
Put the chicken in the large pot and pour in 2800 ml of cold water.
