Put the pot on high heat and bring to a boil. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt.
Skim off the foam.
Turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently. Cook for 25 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece of chicken. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the chicken out. Let it cool for 10 minutes. Shred it into thin pieces with two forks.
Melt the butter in the large pan on medium heat.
Add the onion, the carrots and the pepper. Fry for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add the vegetables to the broth. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and the shredded chicken.
Bring to a boil and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the pepper. Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the carrots are soft, the chicken is white all through, and the broth is clear and golden.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil the broth hard. A hard boil makes it cloudy.
⚠️ Shirataki noodles do not need long cooking. 2 minutes is enough.

meatball_soup_with_vegetables.title: MEATBALL SOUP WITH VEGETABLES
meatball_soup_with_vegetables.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (large pot, 1 pan). Start at T minus 65 min.
equipment: Large pot, 1 pan, bowl, grater, slotted spoon, thermometer

steps.text: Peel the onion. Chop half of it very finely. Chop the other half into small cubes. Keep them in two piles.
Peel the garlic and grate it on the small holes.
Peel the carrots and grate them on the large holes.
Cut the cauliflower into small florets of about 3 cm.
Chop the dill finely.
Put the beef, the finely chopped half of the onion, the garlic, the egg, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper in a bowl.
Mix with your hands for 1 minute, until just combined.
Wet your hands with water. Make 32 small balls, about 20 g each.
Pour 2800 ml of water into the large pot. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt and the bay leaf.
Bring to a boil.
Lower the meatballs into the boiling water one at a time with a spoon.
When it boils again, turn the heat to low. Skim off the foam.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
Push the thermometer into a meatball. It must read at least 74°C.
Melt the butter in the pan on medium heat. Add the cubed onion and the carrots. Fry for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the fried vegetables and the cauliflower to the pot.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cauliflower is soft.
Turn off the heat. Add the dill. Cover the pot and leave it for 10 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the meatballs are firm and reach 74°C, the cauliflower is soft, and the broth is clear and orange.
warnings: ⚠️ Lower the meatballs gently. If you drop them, they break.
⚠️ Do not stir hard in the first 5 minutes. The meatballs are still soft.
meatball_soup_with_vegetables.description_ru: Говяжьи фрикадельки, морковь и цветная капуста

clear_mushroom_soup_friday_no_meat.title: CLEAR MUSHROOM SOUP (Friday, no meat)
clear_mushroom_soup_friday_no_meat.time_line: ⏱ 45 minutes (large pot). Start at T minus 50 min.
equipment: Large pot, grater, slotted spoon

steps.text: Wipe the mushrooms with a damp paper towel. Do not soak them in water.
Cut the mushrooms into slices about 5 mm thick.
Peel the onion and cut it into small cubes. Peel the carrots and grate them on the large holes.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely. Chop the dill finely.
Melt the butter in the large pot on medium heat.
Add the onion and the carrots. Fry for 3 to 5 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the mushrooms.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until all the water has gone and the mushrooms are lightly browned.
Pour in 2800 ml of hot water.
Add the bay leaf, the peppercorns and 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt.
Bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add the garlic, the dill and the black pepper.
Cover the pot and leave it for 10 minutes.
Take out the bay leaf. Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the mushrooms are soft, the broth is clear and amber-brown, and it smells of mushrooms.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not cook the mushrooms longer than 20 minutes in the water. They turn tough.
⚠️ Browning the mushrooms in step 8 gives the soup its flavour. Do not skip it.
clear_mushroom_soup_friday_no_meat.description_ru: Прозрачный суп из грибов с луком и морковью

classic_borscht_with_beef.title: CLASSIC BORSCHT WITH BEEF
classic_borscht_with_beef.time_line: ⏱ About 2 hours (large pot, 1 large pan). Start at T minus 130 min.

ingredients.text: Salt: about 1 teaspoon (see the last steps)
ingredients.name: Salt

equipment: Large pot (4 litres or bigger), large frying pan, grater, slotted spoon

steps.text: Cut the beef into cubes of about 2 x 2 cm.
Pour 2400 ml of COLD water into the large pot. Add the beef.
Put the pot on high heat and bring to a boil.
Skim the grey foam off the top with a slotted spoon. Keep skimming for about 5 minutes.
Turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently. Put the lid on.
Cook for 40 to 50 minutes, then test a piece of beef with a fork.
If it is still hard, cook and test again every 10 minutes. Stewing beef can need up to 1.5 hours.
Peel the beetroot, the carrots and the onions.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Grate the beetroot and the carrots on the large holes of the grater. Your hands will turn red.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Cut the onions into small cubes of about 5 mm.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Heat the oil in the large frying pan on medium heat for 1 minute.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Add the onions. Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Add the carrots and the beetroot. Fry for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring every minute.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: Add the tomato paste and stir. Fry for 2 more minutes.
steps.section: PART 2 - THE VEGETABLES (while the beef cooks)

steps.text: When the beef is soft, scrape all the fried vegetables into the pot.
Add the 3 stock cubes. Stir until they dissolve.
Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Taste a piece of beetroot. It must be soft.
Taste the soup. If it needs salt, add 1/2 teaspoon, stir for 1 minute and taste again. Usually 1 teaspoon is enough, because the stock cubes are salty.
Turn the heat to the lowest setting and keep the pot covered until serving.

ready_when: ✅ BEEF IS READY WHEN: a fork goes in easily and the meat nearly falls apart.
✅ READY WHEN: the beef is soft, the beetroot is soft, and the soup is deep red.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add salt before the stock cubes dissolve. Too much salt cannot be fixed.
classic_borscht_with_beef.description_ru: Классический борщ со свёклой и говядиной

beef_pho_with_shirataki_noodles.title: BEEF PHO WITH SHIRATAKI NOODLES
beef_pho_with_shirataki_noodles.description: A Vietnamese-style soup. The broth simmers for an hour with spices. The beef is cut paper-thin and cooked in the hot broth at the table.
beef_pho_with_shirataki_noodles.time_line: ⏱ About 90 minutes (large pot). Start at T minus 95 min.

ingredients.text: Flank steak (or any lean beef steak): 700 g
ingredients.name: Flank steak (or any lean beef steak)

ingredients.text: Beef stock cube: 1 (or mushroom stock cube)
ingredients.name: Beef stock cube

equipment: Large pot, slotted spoon, sharp knife, colander, big platter

steps.text: Put the steak in the freezer for 30 minutes. It must be firm outside and still a little soft inside.
Peel the onion and cut it into 8 wedges. Peel the garlic and smash each clove with the flat side of a knife.
Slice the ginger into thin rounds.
Cut the limes into wedges. Slice the jalapeños into thin rings.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems.
Heat the oil in the large pot on medium heat.
Add the onion, the ginger, the garlic, the cinnamon, the star anise, the cloves and the cardamom.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring, until the onion browns on all sides.
Pour in 4000 ml of water. Add the stock cube and the fish sauce.
Bring to a boil. Turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently.
Cook for 60 minutes.
Take the steak out of the freezer. Cut it ACROSS the lines of the meat into very thin slices, about 2 mm.
Lay the slices on a platter in one layer. Put the sprouts, basil, jalapeños and limes on another platter.
Rinse the noodles in a colander under cold water for 2 minutes.
With a slotted spoon, lift all the onion and spices out of the broth.
Add the noodles to the broth. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Turn the heat to very low.
Put the steak slices into the hot broth one by one.
Stir gently for 30 seconds. The meat turns grey-brown. Turn the heat off.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the broth is clear and brown and smells of cinnamon and anise, and the beef slices are cooked but still tender.
warnings: ⚠️ Slice the beef very thin and cook it only 30 seconds. Thick or long-cooked slices turn tough.
⚠️ Fish sauce smells strong. This is normal. Do not skip it.
beef_pho_with_shirataki_noodles.title_ru: Фо с говядиной и лапшой ширатаки
beef_pho_with_shirataki_noodles.description_ru: Пряный бульон и тонкие ломтики говядины

cauliflower_mac_and_cheese.title: CAULIFLOWER MAC AND CHEESE
cauliflower_mac_and_cheese.description: Roasted cauliflower in a very cheesy sauce with a crunchy top. No pasta.
cauliflower_mac_and_cheese.time_line: ⏱ 85 minutes (oven, 2 baking trays, large pot). Start at T minus 90 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 340 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: 2 baking trays, baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, large pot, big bowl

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 190°C. Put the shelves in the top and the middle.
Cut the cauliflower into florets of about 4 cm.
Cut the cream cheese into cubes of 2 cm.
Grate the cheddar and the mozzarella on the large holes. Grate the parmesan on the small holes.
Crush the pork rinds into small pieces in a bag with a rolling pin or a bottle.
Put the florets in a big bowl with 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of oil and 1 teaspoon of salt. Toss.
Spread them over the 2 baking trays in one layer.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, swapping the trays after 20 minutes, until tender and golden.
Let the cauliflower cool for 10 minutes.
Pour the cream into the large pot. Heat on medium until small bubbles appear. Do not boil.
Turn the heat to low. Add the cream cheese, the cheddar and the mozzarella.
Stir until all the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Mix the arrowroot with 3 tablespoons of cold water in a cup until smooth.
Take the pot off the heat. Stir in the arrowroot mix.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and the pepper.
Fold the cauliflower into the sauce.
Pour everything into the baking dish.
Mix the pork rinds, the parmesan and 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil in a bowl. Sprinkle it over the dish.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the top is golden.
Let it rest for 5 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the top is golden and crunchy, the sauce bubbles at the edges, and the cauliflower is soft.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil the cheese sauce. It splits and turns oily.
⚠️ Roast the cauliflower on two trays, not one. A crowded tray steams it.
cauliflower_mac_and_cheese.description_ru: Кето мак-н-чиз: запечённая цветная капуста с сырной корочкой

cauliflower_tots_with_spicy_dip.title: CAULIFLOWER TOTS WITH SPICY DIP
cauliflower_tots_with_spicy_dip.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (steamer or pot, oven). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 120 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

ingredients.text: For the dip: mayonnaise 100 g, paprika 1 teaspoon, chili flakes 1/4 teaspoon
ingredients.name: For the dip
ingredients.note: mayonnaise 100 g, paprika 1 teaspoon, chili flakes 1/4 teaspoon

equipment: Pot with a colander or steamer, clean kitchen towel, baking tray, baking paper, big bowl

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 200°C. Cover the baking tray with baking paper.
Cut the cauliflower into small florets.
Grate the cheddar and the parmesan on the small holes.
Crush the pork rinds into fine crumbs in a bag with a rolling pin.
Mix the dip in a small bowl: mayonnaise, paprika and chili flakes. Cover it and put it in the fridge.
Put the florets in a colander over a pot of boiling water, with a lid on top. Steam for 8 minutes until soft.
Let the cauliflower cool for 10 minutes.
Chop it very finely with a sharp knife into pieces the size of rice grains.
Put the chopped cauliflower in a clean kitchen towel. Twist and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Put the cauliflower, the eggs, the cheddar, the parmesan, the pork rinds, the salt and the pepper in a big bowl.
Mix with your hands until everything holds together.
Take 1 tablespoon of the mix and roll it into a small barrel, like a tater tot.
Put the tots on the tray, with a little space between them. Make about 40.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden.
Put the tots on a platter. Put the dip next to them.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the tots are golden and crisp on the outside and hold their shape when you lift them.
warnings: ⚠️ Squeeze the water out well. Wet cauliflower makes tots that fall apart.
⚠️ If the mix is too wet to roll, add 1 more tablespoon of parmesan.
cauliflower_tots_with_spicy_dip.description_ru: Золотистые шарики из цветной капусты с сыром, острый соус

creamed_brussels_sprouts_with_cheese.title: CREAMED BRUSSELS SPROUTS WITH CHEESE
creamed_brussels_sprouts_with_cheese.time_line: ⏱ 70 minutes (pot, large pan, oven). Start at T minus 75 min.

ingredients.text: Salt: 1 tablespoon for the water + 1 1/2 teaspoons for the sauce
ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.note: for the water + 1 1/2 teaspoons for the sauce

equipment: Large pot, large pan, big bowl with ice, colander, baking dish about 23 x 33 cm

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 190°C.
Cut the hard end off each sprout. Cut each sprout in half from top to bottom.
Peel the red onion and cut it into very small cubes. Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the parmesan on the small holes and the mozzarella on the large holes.
Fill a big bowl with ice and cold water.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add 1 tablespoon of salt.
Put the sprouts in the water. Boil for 2 minutes, until they turn bright green.
Drain them in the colander and put them in the ice water for 5 minutes.
Drain them well and put them in the baking dish.
Melt the butter in the large pan on medium-low heat.
Add the onion and the garlic. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring, until soft.
Add the pepper. Pour in the cream and the sour cream.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt. Stir. Take the pan off the heat.
Add the parmesan and half of the mozzarella (60 g). Stir until melted and smooth.
Pour the sauce over the sprouts and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the rest of the mozzarella (60 g) on top.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the top is golden, the sauce bubbles at the edges, and the sprouts are tender when you push a fork in.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not boil the sprouts longer than 2 minutes. They turn grey and smell strong.
⚠️ The ice water in step 8 keeps them green. Do not skip it.
creamed_brussels_sprouts_with_cheese.description_ru: Запечённая в сливочном соусе с сыром

garlic_parmesan_zucchini.title: GARLIC PARMESAN ZUCCHINI
garlic_parmesan_zucchini.time_line: ⏱ 25 minutes (large pan, 2 batches). Start at T minus 30 min.
equipment: Large pan, grater

steps.text: Wash the zucchini. Cut off both ends.
Cut the zucchini into rounds about 1 cm thick.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely.
Grate the parmesan on the small holes of the grater.
Heat the pan on medium heat for 1 minute. Add 1 tablespoon (15 ml) of oil.
Add half of the garlic. Cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add half of the zucchini in one layer.
Cook for 10 minutes, turning the rounds every 2 to 3 minutes, until tender and a little golden.
Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of oregano, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and a tiny pinch of chili flakes.
Move the zucchini to a warm platter. Cover with foil.
Repeat steps 5 to 10 with the second half.
Sprinkle the parmesan over all the zucchini.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the rounds are soft but still keep their shape, and are golden at the edges.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not crowd the pan. Crowded zucchini steams and turns watery and soft.
⚠️ Add the salt only at the end of each batch. Early salt makes the zucchini watery.

oven_roasted_cauliflower_steaks_with_che.title: OVEN-ROASTED CAULIFLOWER STEAKS WITH CHEESE AND BACON
oven_roasted_cauliflower_steaks_with_che.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (oven, 2 baking trays, 1 pan). Start at T minus 65 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 240 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: 2 baking trays, baking paper, large pan, sharp knife, brush or spoon

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 220°C. Put the shelves in the top and the middle.
Cover the 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Cut the leaves off the cauliflower. Trim the stem so the head can stand flat. Keep the core.
Stand a head on its stem. Cut it into slices about 2 cm thick ("steaks"). The 2 middle slices stay whole. Keep the loose florets too.
Peel the garlic and chop it finely. Grate the cheese.
Mix the olive oil, the paprika, the salt and the pepper in a small bowl.
Mix the dressing in another bowl: mayonnaise, garlic and lime juice. Cover and keep in the fridge.
Brush both sides of each steak with the oil mix. Toss the loose florets in the rest of the oil mix.
Lay the steaks and florets on the trays in one layer.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes. Turn the steaks over after 15 minutes. Swap the trays at the same time.
When tender and golden brown in spots, sprinkle the cheese over them.
Roast for 3 to 4 more minutes, until the cheese is melted.
Put the bacon in a cold pan on medium heat.
Fry for 8 minutes, turning once, until crispy.
Move the bacon to paper towel. Crumble it when cool.
Move the steaks and florets to a platter.
Drizzle the dressing over the top in zigzag lines. Scatter the bacon on top.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cauliflower is soft when a knife goes in, golden brown at the edges, and the cheese is melted.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not slice the cauliflower thinner than 2 cm. Thin slices fall apart.
⚠️ Make sure the slices are in one layer. Crowded slices steam instead of roasting.
oven_roasted_cauliflower_steaks_with_che.title_ru: Стейки из цветной капусты с сыром и беконом
oven_roasted_cauliflower_steaks_with_che.description_ru: Запечённая цветная капуста, чеддер и бекон

sesame_peanut_noodles_shirataki.title: SESAME PEANUT NOODLES (shirataki)
sesame_peanut_noodles_shirataki.time_line: ⏱ 20 minutes (1 large pan). Start at T minus 25 min.
equipment: Measuring jug, whisk, colander, large pan

steps.text: Peel the garlic and grate it. Peel the ginger and grate it.
Put the peanut butter, the sesame oil, the tamari, the vinegar, the garlic, the ginger and the chili flakes in a jug.
Whisk until smooth.
Peel the red onion and cut it into thin half-rings.
Open the noodle packs over the sink and pour them into a colander.
Rinse under cold water for 2 minutes. Shake off the water.
Heat the large pan on medium heat for 2 minutes. Add the butter.
Add the noodles. Fry for 3 minutes, stirring, until they squeak and the pan is dry.
Pour the sauce into the pan.
Stir for 1 to 2 minutes until every noodle is coated.
Take the pan off the heat.
Put the noodles in a bowl. Sprinkle the onion and the sesame seeds on top.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the noodles are hot and evenly coated in a brown creamy sauce.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add salt. Tamari is already salty.
⚠️ If the pan is wet in step 8, cook longer before you add the sauce.

cobb_salad.title: COBB SALAD
cobb_salad.description: Chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and tomato on lettuce with a creamy dressing.
cobb_salad.time_line: ⏱ 50 minutes (pot, pan). Start at T minus 55 min.

ingredients.text: Dressing: mayonnaise 120 g, olive oil 45 ml, lime juice 2 tablespoons, mustard 1 tablespoon
ingredients.name: Dressing
ingredients.note: mayonnaise 120 g, olive oil 45 ml, lime juice 2 tablespoons, mustard 1 tablespoon

equipment: Pot, pan, thermometer, large platter, small bowl

steps.text: Put the chicken in a pot and cover it with cold water. Add 1 teaspoon of salt.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the chicken out and let it cool for 15 minutes.
Put the eggs in another pot, cover with cold water by 2 cm, and bring to a boil.
As soon as it boils, turn the heat off, put the lid on and wait 11 minutes.
Pour out the hot water and fill the pot with cold water for 10 minutes. Peel the eggs.
Put the bacon in a cold pan on medium heat. Fry for 8 minutes, turning once, until crispy.
Move the bacon to paper towel. Crumble it when cool.
Cut the chicken into cubes of 1.5 cm.
Cut the eggs into quarters.
Cut the avocados in half, take out the stones and cut the flesh into cubes of 2 cm. Put 1 tablespoon of the lime juice on them.
Cut the tomatoes into cubes of 2 cm. Peel the red onion and cut it into very thin half-rings.
Wash the lettuce. Dry it well. Tear it into pieces of about 5 cm.
Make the dressing: whisk the mayonnaise, the oil, the other tablespoon of lime juice, the mustard, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the pepper in a small bowl.
Spread the lettuce over a large platter.
Lay the chicken, the bacon, the eggs, the avocado, the tomatoes and the onion in separate stripes across the lettuce.
Put the dressing in a small bowl next to the platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: each ingredient is in its own neat stripe and the avocado is still green.
warnings: ⚠️ Cut the avocado last. It turns brown within 30 minutes.
⚠️ Dry the lettuce well. Wet lettuce makes the dressing watery.
cobb_salad.description_ru: Курица, бекон, яйцо, авокадо и помидоры на листьях салата

greek_salad.title: GREEK SALAD
greek_salad.time_line: ⏱ 15 minutes. Start at T minus 20 min.
equipment: Large bowl, sharp knife

steps.text: Wash the cucumbers and the tomatoes.
Cut each cucumber in half lengthwise. Cut the halves into half-moon slices about 1 cm thick.
Cut each tomato into 8 wedges.
Peel the red onion and cut it into thin half-rings.
Cut the feta into cubes of 2 cm.
Put the cucumbers, tomatoes, onion and olives in a large bowl.
Mix the oil, the vinegar, the oregano and the pepper in a cup.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss gently, 4 or 5 turns.
Put the feta on top. Do not mix it in.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the vegetables are coated in oil and the feta is on top in whole cubes.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add salt. Feta and olives are already salty.
⚠️ Make it no more than 20 minutes before serving. The tomatoes make it watery.
greek_salad.description_ru: Огурцы, помидоры, красный лук, фета и маслины

chicken_caesar_salad_with_gluten_free_cr.title: CHICKEN CAESAR SALAD WITH GLUTEN-FREE CROUTONS
chicken_caesar_salad_with_gluten_free_cr.time_line: ⏱ 50 minutes (pot, oven). Start at T minus 55 min.

ingredients.text: Olive oil: 30 ml (2 tablespoons, for the croutons)
ingredients.name: Olive oil

ingredients.text: Dressing: mayonnaise 150 g, parmesan 30 g (from the 100 g), garlic 5 g (1 clove), lime juice 2 tablespoons, mustard 1 teaspoon, black pepper 1/2 teaspoon
ingredients.name: Dressing
ingredients.note: mayonnaise 150 g, parmesan 30 g (from the 100 g), garlic 5 g (1 clove), lime juice 2 tablespoons, mustard 1 teaspoon, black pepper 1/2 teaspoon

equipment: Pot, baking tray, thermometer, grater, large bowl, small bowl

steps.text: Put the chicken in a pot and cover it with cold water. Add 1 teaspoon of salt.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low so it only bubbles gently. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the chicken out and let it cool for 15 minutes.
Turn the oven on to 180°C.
Cut the bread into cubes of 2 cm.
Put the cubes on a baking tray. Pour the oil over them and toss.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring once, until golden and hard.
Let the croutons cool on the tray.
Grate 30 g of parmesan on the small holes. Peel the garlic and crush it very finely.
Whisk the mayonnaise, the grated parmesan, the garlic, the lime juice, the mustard and the pepper in a small bowl.
Wash the lettuce. Dry it well. Tear it into pieces of about 5 cm. Put it in a large bowl.
Cut the chicken into thin slices or cubes of 1.5 cm.
With a vegetable peeler, shave the rest of the parmesan (70 g) into thin curls.
Pour the dressing over the lettuce and toss until every leaf is coated.
Put the salad on a large platter. Lay the chicken on top.
Scatter the croutons and the parmesan curls on top.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the lettuce is lightly coated in dressing and the croutons are still crunchy.
warnings: ⚠️ Add the croutons last. They go soft in 10 minutes.
⚠️ Do not use a bought dressing. It often contains gluten.
chicken_caesar_salad_with_gluten_free_cr.description_ru: Курица, романо, пармезан и безглютеновые сухарики

cheese_salad_with_eggs_and_garlic.title: CHEESE SALAD WITH EGGS AND GARLIC
cheese_salad_with_eggs_and_garlic.time_line: ⏱ 30 minutes, then 20 minutes in the fridge. Start at T minus 55 min.

ingredients.text: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan): 320 g
ingredients.name: Hard cheese (yellow cheddar block, NOT parmesan)

equipment: Pot, grater, bowl

steps.text: Put the eggs in a pot and cover with cold water by 2 cm. Bring to a boil.
As soon as it boils, turn the heat off, put the lid on and wait 11 minutes.
Pour out the hot water and fill the pot with cold water for 10 minutes. Peel the eggs.
Grate the cheese on the large holes of the grater into a bowl.
Grate the eggs on the large holes into the same bowl.
Peel the garlic, crush it with the flat side of a knife and chop it as fine as you can.
Chop the dill finely.
Add the garlic, the dill, the mayonnaise, the pepper and the salt to the bowl.
Mix with a spoon until everything is coated.
Cover and put in the fridge for 20 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the salad is pale yellow and holds together when you press it with a spoon.
warnings: ⚠️ Add the garlic carefully. Raw garlic is strong.
⚠️ Taste it before you serve. If it is too thick, add 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise.
cheese_salad_with_eggs_and_garlic.title_ru: Сырный салат с яйцами и чесноком
cheese_salad_with_eggs_and_garlic.description_ru: Тёртый сыр, яйца, чеснок и майонез

meat_salad_with_avocado_no_potato.title: MEAT SALAD WITH AVOCADO (no potato)
meat_salad_with_avocado_no_potato.description: A salad like the classic Russian one, but with avocado instead of potato.
meat_salad_with_avocado_no_potato.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (2 pots). Start at T minus 65 min.
equipment: 2 pots, thermometer, big bowl, sharp knife

steps.text: Put the chicken in a pot and cover it with cold water. Add 1 teaspoon of salt.
Bring to a boil, then turn the heat to low. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It must read at least 74°C.
Take the chicken out and let it cool for 15 minutes.
Put the whole carrots and the eggs in the second pot. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil.
After 11 minutes, take the eggs out into cold water. Cook the carrots 10 more minutes until soft.
Peel the eggs. Peel the carrots. Let everything cool for 15 minutes.
Cut the chicken into cubes of 1 cm.
Cut the eggs, the carrots and the pickled cucumbers into cubes of 1 cm.
Peel the red onion and cut it into very small cubes. Chop the dill finely.
Cut the avocados in half, take out the stones and cut the flesh into cubes of 1 cm. Mix with the lime juice.
Put the chicken, eggs, carrots, cucumbers, onion and dill in a big bowl.
Add the mayonnaise, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the pepper. Mix gently.
Fold in the avocado at the end, with 3 or 4 turns.
Cover and put in the fridge for 15 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: everything is cut to the same small size and covered in mayonnaise, and the avocado is still in pieces.
warnings: ⚠️ Cool the chicken, eggs and carrots before mixing. Warm food makes the mayonnaise runny.
⚠️ Fold the avocado in last, gently. It turns to mush if you stir it.
meat_salad_with_avocado_no_potato.description_ru: Курица, яйца, огурцы и авокадо вместо картошки

beetroot_salad_with_mayonnaise_and_garli.title: BEETROOT SALAD WITH MAYONNAISE AND GARLIC
beetroot_salad_with_mayonnaise_and_garli.time_line: ⏱ About 100 minutes, mostly waiting. Start at T minus 130 min.
equipment: Large pot, grater, bowl, gloves (optional)

steps.text: Wash the beetroot well under cold water. Do NOT peel it and do NOT cut off the tails.
Put the beetroot in a large pot and cover with cold water, 3 cm above them.
Put the pot on high heat and bring to a boil.
Turn the heat to medium-low so it bubbles gently, and put the lid on.
Cook for 50 to 60 minutes.
Push a knife into the biggest beetroot. If it goes in easily, they are ready. If it is hard, cook 10 more minutes and test again.
Pour out the hot water and fill the pot with cold water. Leave for 10 minutes.
Rub the skin off with your fingers. It slides off easily.
Grate the beetroot on the large holes of the grater into a bowl.
Peel the garlic, crush it with the flat side of a knife, then chop it as fine as you can.
Add the garlic, the mayonnaise and the salt to the beetroot.
Mix with a spoon until the colour is even.
Cover and put in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: deep red and soft, with no hard spots, and the mayonnaise is mixed all the way through.
warnings: ⚠️ Beetroot stains hands, boards and clothes. Wear gloves or wash your hands right after.
beetroot_salad_with_mayonnaise_and_garli.description_ru: Варёная свёкла с майонезом и чесноком

prawn_and_avocado_salad.title: PRAWN AND AVOCADO SALAD
prawn_and_avocado_salad.time_line: ⏱ 30 minutes (pot). Start at T minus 35 min.

ingredients.text: Salt: 1 teaspoon for the water + 1/2 teaspoon for the salad
ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.note: for the water + 1/2 teaspoon for the salad

equipment: Large pot, bowl of ice water, colander, large bowl

steps.text: If the prawns are frozen, thaw them in the fridge overnight.
Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add 1 teaspoon of salt.
Put the prawns in the water. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until they are pink and curled into a loose "C".
Pour them into a colander. Put them in the bowl of ice water for 2 minutes.
Drain them well and pat them dry. Peel them if they have shells.
Cut the avocados in half, take out the stones and cut the flesh into cubes of 2 cm.
Put the avocado in a large bowl with 2 tablespoons of lime juice.
Cut the cucumber into cubes of 1 cm. Peel the red onion and cut it into very thin half-rings.
Make the dressing: peel the garlic and chop it very fine. Mix it with the mayonnaise, the other 2 tablespoons of lime juice, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and the pepper.
Add the prawns, the cucumber and the onion to the avocado.
Pour the dressing over the top.
Mix gently, 3 or 4 turns. Do not mash the avocado.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the prawns are pink and firm, the avocado is in pieces, and everything is lightly coated.
warnings: ⚠️ Prawns need only 2 to 3 minutes. Longer makes them rubbery.
⚠️ Make this salad last, just before serving. Avocado turns brown in 30 minutes.

berries_with_sour_cream_and_honey.title: BERRIES WITH SOUR CREAM AND HONEY
berries_with_sour_cream_and_honey.description: A very light dessert. It can also be served at breakfast.
berries_with_sour_cream_and_honey.time_line: ⏱ 15 minutes. Start at T minus 20 min.

ingredients.text: Berries (raspberries, strawberries, blueberries or a mix): 800 g
ingredients.name: Berries (raspberries, strawberries, blueberries or a mix)

equipment: Colander, large bowl, small bowl

steps.text: Put the berries in a colander and rinse under cold water for 30 seconds.
Let them drain for 5 minutes.
Cut the green tops off any strawberries. Cut large strawberries in half.
Put all the berries in a large bowl. Cover it and keep it in the fridge.
Put the cold sour cream in a small bowl. Stir it for 20 seconds until smooth.
Just before serving, put the sour cream on top of the berries in big spoonfuls.
Drizzle the honey over the sour cream.
Do not stir. Serve at once with a big spoon.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the berries are covered with sour cream and a drizzle of honey on top.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not add the sour cream too early. The berries leak juice and the dessert turns watery.
berries_with_sour_cream_and_honey.description_ru: Свежие ягоды, холодная сметана и мёд

baked_berry_custard.title: BAKED BERRY CUSTARD
baked_berry_custard.description: A soft baked egg custard with raspberries. It can also be served at breakfast.
baked_berry_custard.time_line: ⏱ 65 minutes (oven). Start at T minus 70 min, or make it earlier and serve cold.
equipment: Baking dish about 23 x 33 cm, a bigger deep tray for hot water, pot, whisk, jug, thermometer

steps.text: Turn the oven on to 160°C. Put the shelf in the middle.
Boil a kettle or a pot of water. You need about 1.5 litres.
Heat the milk in a pot on medium heat until small bubbles appear at the edge. Do not boil.
Crack the eggs into a big bowl. Add the honey and the vanilla.
Whisk for 1 minute until pale and smooth.
Pour the hot milk into the eggs in a thin stream, whisking all the time.
Pour the mixture through a sieve into a jug.
Spread the raspberries over the bottom of the baking dish.
Put the baking dish inside the bigger tray on the oven shelf.
Pour the custard mixture over the raspberries.
Pour the hot water into the bigger tray, until it reaches halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
Shake the dish gently. The middle should still wobble a little, like jelly.
Push the thermometer into the middle. It must read at least 77°C.
Take the baking dish out of the hot water. Let it cool for 30 minutes.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the custard is set at the edges, wobbles slightly in the middle, and reads 77°C or more.
warnings: ⚠️ Do not let the milk boil in step 3. It would cook the eggs in the bowl.
⚠️ The water bath is important. Without it the custard turns rubbery.
baked_berry_custard.description_ru: Яичный крем с малиной, запечённый в духовке

flour_free_crepes_with_berries.title: FLOUR-FREE CREPES WITH BERRIES
flour_free_crepes_with_berries.description: 2 crepes per portion. Thin crepes made with arrowroot instead of flour.
flour_free_crepes_with_berries.time_line: ⏱ 60 minutes (large non-stick pan). Start at T minus 65 min.
equipment: Big bowl, whisk, sieve, large non-stick pan (about 24 cm), ladle, spatula, foil

steps.text: Crack the eggs into a big bowl. Add the milk, the vanilla and the salt.
Whisk for 30 seconds.
Add the arrowroot a little at a time, whisking all the time.
Pour the batter through a sieve into a jug, to take out lumps.
Let it rest for 15 minutes.
Melt the butter and stir 2 teaspoons into the batter.
Cut large strawberries in half. Wash and drain all the berries.
Mix the sour cream and the honey in a bowl.
Heat the pan on medium heat for 2 minutes. Rub it with a little melted butter.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Stir the batter. Pour in 1 ladle (about 70 ml) and tilt the pan so the batter covers the bottom.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Cook for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes, until the edges lift and the top looks dry.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Flip the crepe with a spatula. Cook for 30 seconds.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Move it to a plate and cover with foil. Stir the batter before each crepe.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Repeat steps 10 to 13 until all the batter is used.
steps.section: COOK (16 crepes, one at a time)

steps.text: Put 1 tablespoon of sour cream mix and some berries on each crepe.
Fold it in half, then in half again.
Put them on a platter.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the crepes are thin, pale gold, flexible and do not tear when folded.
warnings: ⚠️ This is a flour-free batter. The crepes are thinner and a bit chewier than normal crepes. This is expected.
⚠️ Stir the batter before every crepe. The arrowroot sinks to the bottom.
flour_free_crepes_with_berries.description_ru: Тонкие блинчики на арроуруте с ягодами и сметаной

peanut_butter_and_honey_balls.title: PEANUT BUTTER AND HONEY BALLS
peanut_butter_and_honey_balls.description: 24 small balls, 3 per portion. Make them ahead.
peanut_butter_and_honey_balls.time_line: ⏱ 20 minutes of work and 30 minutes in the fridge. Start at T minus 60 min.
equipment: Bowl, spoon, baking tray, baking paper, cling film

steps.text: Cover the baking tray with baking paper.
Put the peanut butter, the honey, the vanilla and the salt in a bowl.
Mix with a spoon for 1 to 2 minutes until smooth and thick.
Put the bowl in the fridge for 15 minutes so the mixture firms up.
Wet your hands with cold water.
Take 1 heaped tablespoon of the mixture and roll it into a ball.
Put the ball on the tray. Repeat to make 24 balls.
Cover the tray with cling film.
Put the tray in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Put the balls on a platter just before serving.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the balls are firm, hold their shape and are not sticky to the touch.
warnings: ⚠️ If the mixture is too soft to roll, put it back in the fridge for 10 more minutes.
⚠️ Keep them cold. They get soft at room temperature after 30 minutes.
peanut_butter_and_honey_balls.title_ru: Шарики из арахисовой пасты с мёдом

warm_cherries_with_vanilla_and_sour_crea.title: WARM CHERRIES WITH VANILLA AND SOUR CREAM
warm_cherries_with_vanilla_and_sour_crea.description: It can also be served at breakfast.
warm_cherries_with_vanilla_and_sour_crea.time_line: ⏱ 50 minutes, most of it is taking out the stones. Start at T minus 55 min.
equipment: Medium pot, small bowl, sharp knife, 2 bowls (one for stones)

steps.text: Wash the cherries and remove the stalks.
Cut each cherry in half around the middle.
Remove the stone with the tip of the knife.
Put the halves in a bowl and the stones in another bowl.
Mix the arrowroot with 3 tablespoons of cold water in a cup until smooth.
Put the cherries, the honey and 100 ml of water in the pot.
Heat on medium heat for 3 minutes, until the juice starts to run.
Turn the heat to low. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir the arrowroot mix and pour it in.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until the juice is thicker and shiny.
Take the pot off the heat. Stir in the vanilla.
Let it stand for 5 minutes.
Spoon the warm cherries into a large bowl.
Put the cold sour cream in a small bowl next to it, with a spoon.

ready_when: ✅ READY WHEN: the cherries are soft but still hold their shape, and the juice is thick, dark red and shiny.
warnings: ⚠️ Check the cherries again for stones before serving.
⚠️ Do not boil the cherries hard. They fall apart.
warm_cherries_with_vanilla_and_sour_crea.description_ru: Вишня с мёдом и ванилью, холодная сметана
